verses.text: Amaute, Egypt gam panin a paikhiatkhit zawh uh a kum nihna kum sung, a Kha Nihna a ni Masa ni-in Sinai sehnel gam, Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Yahweh in Mosheh hopih a, a gen inah:
“Israyl mi honte khempeuh, a behbehin, a innkuankuanin, pasal peuhmah a min tawh gualin mi khat khit mi khat mi simna na nei ding hi.
Nang leh Aaron in Israyl sungah kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a pha, Israyl aa dingin gal a do thei ding Israyl sunga pasal khempeuh a honhonin na sim ding uh hi.
Minam khat panin khat ciat in note hong huh ding a, khat ciat pen a beh lutang hi ding hi.
Hihte pen note tawh hong huh dingte min ahi hi: Reuben minam panin Shedeur’ tapa Elizur,
Simeon minam panin Zurishaddai’ tapa’ Shelumiel,
Yahdah minam panin Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon,
Issachar minam panin Zuar’ tapa Nethaneel,
Zebulun minam panin Helon’ tapa Eliab,
Yahseph minam nih ahi: Ephraim panin Ammihud’ tapa Elishama, leh Menasheh minam panin Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel;
Benyamin minam panin Gideoni’ tapa Abidan,
Dan minam panin Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer,
Asher minam panin Ocran’ tapa Pagiel,
Gad minam panin Deuel’ tapa Eliasaph,
Naphtali minam panin Enan’ tapa Ahira-te ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen amau’ phung sung panin a makaite, mihonpi sung panin a kiteelkhia mite ahi uh hi. Amaute pen Israyl behte’ lutangte ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh leh Aaron in a min tawh a kisam hih mite la uh a,

amaute in a Kha Nihna a Ni Masa ni-in mihonpi khempeuh kaikhawm uh hi. Mi khat ciat in a behbeh, a innkuankuanin amau phung zui-in ciamteh uh hi. Kum 20 pan a tungsiah a pha mite pen a min tawh kigualin khat khit khat kiciamteh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa bangin amah in Sinai Sehnel gam sungah amaute a sim hi.

Israyl’ tacil, Reuben’ suanlekhakte panin gal a do dingin a kuan thei, kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh pen amau’ beh leh a innkuan ciaptehna tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Reuben minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 46,500 ahi hi.
Simeon’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Simeon minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 59,300 ahi hi.
Gad’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Gad minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 45,650 ahi hi.
Yahdah’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Yahdah minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 74,600 ahi hi.
Issachar’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Issachar minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 54,400 ahi hi.
Zebulun’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Zebulun minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 57,400 ahi hi.

Yahseph minam ahi: Ephraim’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Ephraim minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 40,500 ahi a,
Menasheh’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Menasheh minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 32,200 ahi hi.
Benyamin’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Benyamin minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 35,400 ahi hi.
Dan’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Dan minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 62,700 ahi hi.
Asher’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Asher minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 41,500 ahi hi.
Naphtali’ suanlekhakte panin gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh amau beh leh innkuan ciaptehnate tawh kizui-in a min tawh gualin khat khit khat a kiciamteh hi;
Naphtali minam panin a kisim tua pasalte pen 53,400 ahi hi.
Hihte pen Mosheh, Aaron leh amau’ phungpi inn khat ciat tangin a ding Israyl makai sawm le nihte in a sim uh mite ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl sunga gal do dingin a kuan thei kum 20 pan a tungsiah a pha Israyl’ tapate khempeuh pen amau’ innkuante tawh kizui-in a kisim ahi hi.
A kisim tua pasalte khempeuh a vekin 603,550 ahi hi.
Ahih hangin amaute lakah Levi mite amau’ phung minam tawh kisim lo hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah thugenkhin a, a gen inah:
“Note in Levi minam na sim peuhmah kei ding uh a, Israyl mi kisimna lakah zong amaute na kihelsak kei ding uh hi.

Note in Tecipanna biakbuk leh a sung nazat khempeuh, leh tua tawh a kisai na khempeuh a uk dingin Levi’ suante na seh ding uh hi. Amaute pen biakbuk leh a nazat khempeuh a pua dingte hi uh a, amaute in tua pen don ding uh a, a kiimkot ah giahphual sat ding uh hi.

Biakbuk a kikhin ding peuh ciangin, Levi’ suanlekhakte in phel ding uh a, biakbuk a kidinsak ding peuh ciangin, Levi’ suanlekhakte pen a lam dingte ahi uh hi. Tua kiim a nai-a a pai mi dang peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Mi khat ciatin giahphual ciat, amau’ dialkhai gei ciatah, a khenkhenin Israyl mite in amau’ puanbukte lam ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin Levi mite in Tecipanna biakbuk kiimkot ah lam ding uh hi; tua hileh Israyl mihonpi tungah sinsona hong tung lo ding hi. Levi’ suante pen Tecipanna biakbuk a don dingin vaipuak a neite ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak khempeuh bangin Israyl mite in a hih uh hi. Amaute in hihpah uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mi peuhpeuh in a pa’ inn dialkhai gei, amau dialkhai nuai ciat ah om ding hi. Amaute in Kikhopna Puanbuk panin a kigamla simsimin lam ding uh hi.
A mai lam, nisuahna lam pangah amau’ dialkhai nuai-a giahphual a sat ding pen Yahdah’ giahphual honte ahi hi. Yahdah mi makaipa pen Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 74,600 pha hi.
Issachar minam in Yahdah zom ah giahphual sat ding uh hi. Issachar mi makaipa pen Zuar’ tapa Nethaneel ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 54,400 pha hi.
Zebulun minam in Isaachar zom ah hi ding hi. Zebulun mi makaipa pen Helon’ tapa Eliab ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 57,400 pha hi.
Yahdah’ giahphual ah mi khempeuh kisim hi; Yahdah, Isaachar leh Zebulun minamte panin a kisim mi 186,400 pha hi. Hihte in giahphual phelin dingkhia masa ding uh hi.
Leitaw lam pangah Reuben’ giahphual honte amau’ dialkhai nuai-ah om ding hi. Reuben minam makaipa pen Shedeur’ tapa Elizur ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 46,500 pha hi.
Reuben zom ah Simeon minam in giahphual sat ding uh hi. Simeon minam makaipa pen Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 59,300 pha hi.
Simeon zom ah Gad minamte giahphual kisat ding hi. Gad minam makaipa pen Deuel’ tapa Eliasaph ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 46,500 pha hi.
Reuben’ giahphual ah mi khempeuh kisim hi; Reuben, Simeon, leh Gad minamte panin a kisim mi 151,450 pha hi. Amaute in giahphual phelin a nihna-in paikhia ding uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk leh Levi minamte giahphual pen giahphualte laizangah kikhin khawm ding hi. A giahphual sat lai-a bangin amaute a gualgualin amau’ dialkhai nuai, amau’ mun ciat ah dingkhia uh hi.
Ni tumna lam pangah Ephraim giahphual honte amau’ dialkhai nuai-ah om ding hi. Ephraim minam makaipa pen Ammihud’ tapa Elishama ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 40,500 pha hi.
Ephraim zom ah Menasheh minam om ding hi. Menasheh minam makaipa pen Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 32,200 pha hi.
A zom ah Benyamin minam om ding hi. Benyamin minam makaipa pen Gideoni’ tapa Abidan ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 35,400 pha hi.

Ephraim’ giahphual ah mi khempeuh kisim hi; Ephraim, Menasheh leh Benyamin minamte panin a kisim mi pen 108,100 pha hi. Amaute in giahphual phelin, Levi minam leh Kikhopna Puanbuk gei-ah amaute a thumna-in paikhia ding uh hi.
Leilu lam pangah Dan giahphual honte amau’ dialkhai nuai-ah om ding hi. Dan minam makaipa pen Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 62,700 pha hi.
Dan zom ah Asher minam in giahphual sat ding hi. Asher minam makaipa pen Ocran’ tapa Pagiel ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 41,500 pha hi.
A zom ah Naphtali minam om ding hi. Naphtali minam makaipa pen Enan’ tapa Ahira ahi hi;
Ama pawl pen 53,400 pha hi.
Dan’ giahphual ah mi khempeuh kisim hi; Dan, Asher, leh Naphtali minamte panin a kisim mi 157,600 pha hi. Amaute in giahphual phelin amau’ dialkhaite nuai-ah a nunung penin paikhia ding uh hi.
Hihte pen amau’ innkuan tawh kizui-in a kisim Israyl mite ahi hi. Amau’ pawlte tawh kizui-in a kisim giahphualte sunga om pasal khempeuh 603,500 ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin Israyl mite lak ah Levi minam kisim lo hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin Israyl mite in hih uh hi. Amau’ beh ciat leh a innkuan ciatin tua bang danin amau’ dialkhaite nuai-ah giahphual sat uh a, tua bang mahin a giahphual uh phelin dingkhia uh hi.
Hihte pen Sinai Mual tungah Yahweh in Mosheh a hopih lai-in Aaron leh Mosheh-te’ innkuan sung suanlekhakte ahi hi;
Hihte pen Aaron’ tapate minte ahi hi: Tapa upa pen Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi hi.
Hihte pen siampi nasep a sem dingin sehtuamin a kikipsak, sathau kinilh siampite ahi Aaron’ tapate minte ahi hi:

ahih hangin Sinai Sehnel gam sungah giahphual a sat lai-in amaute in Yahweh mai-ah zahtak loin leh phalna ngah lo pi-in mei tawh biakna a piak uh ciangin Nadab leh Abihu pen Yahweh’ mai panin si uh hi. Amaute in tapa nei lo uh hi; tua ahih manin Eleazar leh Ithamar bek in a pa uh Aaron nuntak hun sungin siampi nasep sem uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Levi minamte a nai-ah hong paipih inla, amaute in Siampi Lian Aaron a huh theih nadingun Aaron mai-ah amaute hong paipih in.
Amaute in Kikhopna Puanbuk ah biakbuk nasep sem dingin ama aa ding leh mipi bup aa dingin a vaipuakte uh sem ding hi.
Amaute in Kikhopna Puanbuk nazatte khempeuh don ding uh a, Israyl mite tangin biakbuk nasep sepna tawh Israyl mite hih ding ngeina teng tangtungsak ding uh hi.
Nangmah in Aaron kiangah Levi mite leh ama tapate na pia ding hi. Amaute pen Israyl mite lak panin Kei tungah a kipumpiak ahi hi.
Siampi nasep a sem dingin Aaron leh a tapate seh in. Mun Siangtho sungah adang khatpeuh a lut peuhmah pel loin kithat ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
Kei, Kei mahmah, in Israyl mite lak panin naubu a hong ta pasal masa peuhpeuh tangin Israyl mite lak panin Levi mite ka lakhin zo hi. Tua ahih manin Levi mite pen Kei aa hi ding hi;

bang hang hiam cihleh tacil khempeuh Keima aa ahi hi. Egypt gam sunga tacil khempeuh ka vatmang ni-in, mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh Israyl sunga tacil khempeuh Kei aa dingin siangthosakin ka tuamkoih hi. Amaute pen Kei aa ding ahi hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Tua tak ciangin Sinai Sehnel gam sungah Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Levi mite amau’ innkuan leh a beh zui-in sim in. Kha khat panin a tungsiah a pha pasal peuhmah sim in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh’ kammal tawh amah thu a kipiak bangin Mosheh in amaute sim hi.
Hihte pen Levi’ tapate minte ahi hi: Gershon, Kohath, leh Merari ahi hi.
Hihte pen a beh tawh kizui-in Gershon’ tapate minte ahi hi: Libni leh Shimei ahi hi.
A beh zui-in Kohath’ tapate pen Amram, Izehar, Hebron, leh Uzziel ahi uh hi.
A beh zui-in Merari’ tapate pen Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi. Hihte pen amau’ innkuan tawh kizui-in Levi behte ahi hi.
Gershon panin Libni mite’ beh leh Shimi mite beh piang hi. Hihte pen Gershon mite’ behte ahi hi.
Kha khat pan a tungsiah a pha, a kisim pasal khempeuh phazah pen 7,500 ahi hi.
Gershon mite’ behte pen biakbuk nung lam pang, nitumna lam ah giahphual sat dingte ahi uh hi.
Gershon mi’ phungpite makaipa pen Lael’ tapa Eliasaph ahi hi.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga Gershon mite vaipuak pen biakbuk, puanbuk leh a khuhnate, Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna kongpuan,
buktual-a puankhaite, biakbuk leh biaknatau kiimkot-a om buktual lutna-a puankhaite, khauhualte, leh a zat na tawh a kizom khempeuh ahi hi.
Kohath panin Amram mite’ beh, Izehar mite’ beh, Hebron’ mite beh, leh Uzziel mite’ beh piang hi. Hihte pen Kohath mite’ behte ahi hi.
Kha khat panin a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh pen 8,600 ahi hi.
Kohath mite’ behte pen biakbuk’ leitaw lam pangah giahphual sat dingte ahi uh hi.
Kohath mite beh phungpite’ makaipa pen Uzziel’ tapa Elizaphan ahi hi.
Amaute hih ding pen thuciamna singkuang, a sabuai, a meivakkhuam, a biaknataute, biakna nasepna-a a kizang munsiangtho nazatte, Dalna puan, leh amau na zat tawh kizom khempeuh a don ding uh ahi hi.
Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar pen Levi mi makaite’ tungah a ukpi ding, munsiangtho a don ding mite a vaan ding ahi hi.
3 Merari panin Mahli mite’ beh leh Mushi mite’ beh piang hi. Hihte pen Merari’ behte ahi hi.
Kha khat panin a tungsiah a pha, a kisim pasal phazah khempeuh pen 6,200 ahi hi.
Merari’ beh phungpite’ makaipa pen Abihail’ tapa Zuriel ahi hi. Amaute pen biakbuk’ leilu lam ah giahphual sat dingte ahi uh hi.
Merari’ behte pen biakbuk khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite, khuam bullente, a nengnengte khempeuh leh amau na zat tawh a kizom khempeuh a don dingin a kiseh ahi hi.
Buktual kiimkot-a khuampite leh a bullente tawh, puanbuk khetphimte leh a khauhualte zong ahi hi.

Nisuahna lam pang biakbuk mai, Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-a giahphual satte pen Mosheh, Aaron leh a tapate ahi uh hi. Amaute in Israyl mite tangin Munsiangtho a don ding a vaipuak uh ahi hi. Munsiangtho; Mun Siangtho leh A Siangtho Pen Mun, nai-ah hong pai mi dang peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Mosheh leh Aaron in Yahweh thupiakna bangin amau’ behte uh tawh kizui-in a sim Levi mi pasal kha khat panin a tungsiah peuhmah a veka kigawm pen 22,000 a pha hi.
Tua khit tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Kha khat panin a tungsiah a pha Israyl mi tacil pasal khempeuh sim inla, amau’ minte ciamteh in.

Kei aa dingin Israyl mite lak panin tacil khempeuh tang dingin Levi mite la inla, Israyl mite gankhawi lak panin tacil khempeuh tang dingin Levi mite gankhawite nong lasak ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in amah thu a piak bangin Mosheh in Israyl mite lak panin tacil khempeuh a sim hi.
Kha khat panin a tungsiah a pha, a min tawh a kigual tacil pasal khempeuh pen 22,273 a pha hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen in ah:
“Israyl mite lak panin tacil khempeuh tang dingin Levi mite la inla, amau gankhawite tang dingin Levi mite gankhawite la in. Levi mite pen Keima aa hi ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Levi mi phazah valin a tamzaw Israyl mi tacil 273-te tatna dingin,
mi khat ciat aa dingin shekel khat ah gerah 20 a gik munsiangtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel 5 ta khol in.
Israyl mi a tamzaw teng a kitatna uh sumte pen Aaron leh a tapate tungah pia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in Levi mite ban-ah a val lai mite tung panin kitatna sumte kaikhawm hi.
Israyl mi tacilte kiang panin munsiangtho shekel tawh kizui-in amah in ngun shekel 1,365 kaikhawm hi.
Yahweh’ kammal tawh amah thu a kipiaksa bangin Mosheh in Aaron leh a tapate tungah amaute kitatna sum a pia hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah a gen inah:
“Levi mite lak panin Kohath’ tapate amau’ beh leh a pate’ innkuante tawh kizui-in misimna nei in.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga nasepna ah a sem dingin a pai ding kum 30 panin kum 50 a pha pasal khempeuh sim in.
Hih pen Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Kohath’ tapate sep ding ahi hi: a siangtho pen nate a don ding uh ahi hi.
Giahphual a kisuan ding ciangin, Aaron leh a tapate a sungah tumin Dalna puan khia ding uh a, tua puan tawh Tecipanna singkuang khuh ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in keelvunte tawh tuam ding uh a, tua tungah puan a dum kiuhkeuh tawh khuhin, a mun ah a zawlte khum ding uh hi.

Ompihna anlum sabuai tungah amaute in puan dum phah ding uh a, tua tunga a pakante, sikkeu letna saute, kuangkumte, leh dawna biaknate aa dinga thawl gongbak letna neite koih in. A kikoih tawntung anlum tua tungah om ding hi.
Hihte tungah amaute in a ausan puan tawh khuh thuahin, tua pen keelvunte tawh tuam ding uh a, a mun ah zawlte khum ding uh hi.
Amaute in puan dum khat la-in, mei vakna meivakkhuam, a meivakte, a taitehte, a kuangte, leh sathau thun nadinga a kizang thawl gongbak letna neite khempeuh tuam ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in keelvun tuamna sungah tuate leh a nazat khempeuh tunin a puak nading taal tungah koih ding uh hi.
Kham biaknatau tungah amaute in puan dum khat phah ding uh a, keelvunte tawh tuamin a zawlte a khum ding uh hi.
Amaute in munsiangtho sunga biak nasep nadinga a kizang nate khempeuh la ding uh a, puan dum tawh tuunin, keelvunte tawh tuam ding uh a, taal tungah tuate a koih ding uh hi.
Amaute in sumngo biaknatau panin vutte luakkhia ding uh a, a tungah puan a dupsan khat phah ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin biaknatau-a biak nasep nadinga a kizang um-le-beelte khempeuh tua lai-ah koih ding uh a, meibung, sa thukna sikka, vutluahna leh thehna thawl gongbakte zong kihel ding hi.

Aaron leh a tapate in biakna-a vanzat siangthote leh biakna na siangthote khempeuh a tuunkhit uh giahphual a kisuan ciangin, Kohath’ suante pen a puak nasep a sem dingte ahi uh hi; ahih hangin amaute in a siangtho nate lawng lo ding uh hi, tua bang hi keileh amaute si ding uh hi. Kohath mite pen Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga om nate a pua dingte ahi uh hi.

Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar in meivak aa ding sathau, a namtui gim namtui, a hunhuna an tawh biakna, leh nilh sathau a uk ding hi. Amah in biakbuk buppi leh a sunga om khempeuh uk ding pa hi a, vanzat siangthote leh biakna nazatte zong kihel hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah a gen inah:

“Levi mite lak panin Kohath mite’ beh minamte beimangsak kei un; kiciat lohna khatpeuh tungtawnin ahi a, nang sehtan tunga manh khat peuh deihna tungtawnin ahi zongin Kohath mite in sihna a thuak khak loh nadingin don in.*
Tua hileh a siangtho pen nate nai-ah hong pai uh ciangin amaute nungta ding a, si lo ding uh hi. Amaute hicisak in: Aaron leh a tapate pai-in amau sep ding leh a puak ding ciat uh seh ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a siangtho nate a kikhuh laitakin a en dingin amaute lut lo ding uh hi, tua bang hi keileh si ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
A innkuankuan, a behbeh zui-in Gershon suante kisimna zong bawl in.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah na sem dingin a pai thei kum 30 pan kum 50 a pha pasal khempeuh sim in.
Hih pen nasep leh van puak ciangin Gerhon behte nasep ahi hi:
Amaute in biakbuk dalna puante, Kikhopna Puanbuk, a khuhna leh keelvun tawh a pualam khuhna, Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna kongpuante,
biakbuk leh biaknatau kiimkot-a buktual dalna puante, buktual kongpi puankhaite, khau hualte leh nasepna-a a kizang nazat khempeuh pua ding uh hi. Tua mah bangin amaute in a sem uh hi.
Aaron leh a tapate in Gershon mite’ nasep khempeuh, a kiseh nasepte leh amau sep ding khempeuh Aaron leh a tapate in thupia ding uh hi. Amau’ sep dingte khempeuh amau vaipuakin na seh pah ding uh hi.
Hih pen Kikhopna Puanbuk ah Gershon behte nasep ahi hi. Amau’ nasepna in siampi Aaron’ tapa Ithamar makaihna bangbang hi ding hi.
A innkuankuan, a behbeh zui-in Merari’ suante sim in.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah na sem dingin a pai thei kum 30 pan kum 50 a pha pasal khempeuh sim in.
Hih pen Kikhopna Puanbuk ah amaute sep ding uh ahi amau’ vaipuak ahi hi: biakbuk khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite, khuam bullente pua ding uh hi;

buktual kiimkot khuampite leh a bullente, puanbuk khet phimte, khauhualte, amau vanzatte leh amau’ nazatte tawh a kizom peuhmah zong pua ding uh hi. Amau’ min ciat zui-in a puak ding uh nate na seh ding hi.
Hih pen siampi Aaron’ tapa Ithamar makaihna bangbangin Merari suante in Kikhopna Puanbuk ah a sep ding uh nasep ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh, Aaron leh mihon makaite in Kohath mi pasal a innkuankuan leh a behbehin sim uh hi.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah na sem dingin a pai thei kum 30 pan kum 50 a pha pasal khempeuh,
a behbehin a kisim pen 2,750 a pha hi.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga nasem Kohath behte khempeuh a vekpi-in hih teng ahi hi. Yahweh in Mosheh tungtawnin a thupiak bangin Mosheh leh Aaron in a sim uh hi.
A behbeh, a innkuankuanin Gershon’ suante a kisim hi.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah na sem dingin a pai thei kum 30 pan kum 50 a pha pasal khempeuh,
a behbeh, a innkuankuanin a kisim pen 2,630 a pha hi.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga nasem Gershon behte khempeuh a vekpi-in hih teng ahi hi. Yahweh’ thupiakna tawh kizui-in Mosheh leh Aaron in amaute a sim uh hi.
A behbeh, a innkuankuanin Merari’ suan innkuante a kisim hi.
Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah na sem dingin a pai thei kum 30 pan kum 50 a pha pasal khempeuh,
a behbehin a kisim pen 3,200 a pha hi.
Merari behte khempeuh a vekpi-in hih teng ahi hi. Mosheh khut tawh a kigelh Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in Mosheh leh Aaron in amaute a sim uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh, Aaron leh Israyl makaite in Levi’ suante khempeuh a behbeh, a innkuankuan zui-in a sim uh hi.
Puanbuk’ na a sem ding leh a pua dingin a pai kum 30 pan kum 50 a pha pasal khempeuh—
tua a kisim mite pen 8,580 a pha hi.

Yahweh’ thupiakna tawh kizui-in, amau’ nasep ciat tawh kizui-in leh amau a kiseh vaipuak ciat tawh kizui-in Mosheh khut tawh a kisim hi; tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin amaute a kisim hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite in mi phak peuhmah, a kilawh thei vun natna a nei peuhmah, misi khatpeuh hangin a ninte khempeuh giahphual pua ah a koihkhiat nadingun Israyl mite thupia in.
Pasal leh numei a kibangin paikhiasak in; giahphual pualam ah amaute na koih ding uh hi, tua hileh amau’ laka Ka tenna amau’ giahphual a ninsak lo ahi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bangin Israyl mite in hih uh hi. Yahweh in Mosheh tungah a gen bangin Israyl-te in giahphual pualam ah a koih uh hi. Tua bangin Israyl mite in a hih pah uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen in ah:
“Israyl mite kiangah, ‘Pasal khat ahih keileh numei khatpeuh in mite tungah a man lo khatpeuh khial-in, Yahweh tungah a cihtak loh ciangin, tua mi pen a khial hi a,

a hing lai ahih keileh a sisa’ neihsa zat thaangsak ahih keileh a muanna bangin a gamtat kei leh, a khialhsa mawhna pulak pelmawh ding hi. Amah in a gamtat khialhna hangin a kicing takin ditkikna bawl ding a, a man zah nga-ah-khat behlapin, a khialhnapa tungah pia ding hi.

Ahih hangin a mipa in, tua khialhna hanga ditkikna a sang ding tanau a neih kei leh, ama aa ding mawhkhuhna a kibawlsakna, mawhkhuhna tuutal tawh tua khialhna hanga ditkikna pen siampite aa dingin Yahweh’ kiangah tung pelmawh ding hi.
Amaute in siampite kiangah a paipih uh Israyl mite a siangtho nate khempeuh tawh biakna peuhmah ama aa hi ding hi.
Mi khempeuh’ na a siangthote ama aa hi ding hi. Mi khatpeuh in siampipa tungah a piak peuhmah ama aa hi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Mi khatpeuh’ zi vakvai-in a pasal palhngulh a,
pasal khatpeuh tawh lumkhawmin, tua nu kininsak napi-in kuamah in phawk loin, a khialh laitakin tua nu kiman lo ahih manin a langah a pang ding teci a om loh hangin,
a pasal in upmawhna lungsim nei-in, a kininsak tawm a zi a up mawh leh, ahih keileh, a numei kininsak lo napi-in, a pasal in upmawhna lungsim nei-in a zi a upmawh leh,

mipa in siampipa kiangah a zi paipih ding hi. Amah in a zi aa dingin a kisam biakna, mangbuhham ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat paipih ding hi. A tungah sathau sung loin, gim namtui zong koih lo ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen Upmawhna hanga An tawh Biakna, mawhna phawkkikna dinga phawkkikna biakna ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in tua nu paipihin Yahweh mai-ah dingsak ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in leibeel khat sungah tui siangtho la ding a, biakbuk sual tunga om leivui tawm khat la-in tua tui sungah khah ding hi.

Siampipa in Yahweh mai-ah numeinu a dinsak khit ciangin, a sam phelsakin, numei’ lutang khuh lo ding a, Upmawhna hanga An tawh Biakna ahi phawkkikna biakna a khut sungah koih ding hi. Siampipa in ama khut sungah samsiatna a tun tuikha tawi ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin siampipa in amah kiciamsakin, ama kiangah, “Na pasal’ zi-a a om sungin, kuamah in nang hong luppih loin, nitna lamah a kihel lo na hih leh, hih tuikha in nang tungah samsiatna hong tun lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin na pasal’ zi-a a om sungin, nangmah lampial khinin, na pasal ahi lo khatpeuh tawh lupkhopna tawh nang-le-nang na kinitsakkhit leh,

hih lai mun ah siampipa in hih samsiat kiciamna nuai-ah numei nu koih ding a, amah in nupi nu kiangah, ‘Yahweh in na pheipi theepsakin na gil a puaksakin; lungkhamna tampi tawh ta nei lo hong suahsak ciangin, Yahweh in nangmah hong kisamsiasak ding hi.

Hih tui in khialhna a kilangsak samsiatna hong tun henla, na pumpi sungah lut ding hi, tua hileh na gil puakin na phei theep ding a, lungkhamna tampi tawh ta nei lo na suak ding hi. Tua tak ciangin nupi nu in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen. Tua bangin hi tahen,’ a ci ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in hih samsiatnate laizial khat tungah gelh ding a, tui kha sungah tuate silkhia ding hi.
Amah in samsiatna a tun tuikha pen nupi nu dawnsak ding a, hih tui pen nupi nu sungah lutin nasak velval ding hi.
Siampipa in nupi nu’ khut sung panin upmawhna hanga an tawh biakna la ding a, Yahweh mai-ah biakna-in vei-in, biaknatau ah paipih ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in phawkna biakna sehtanhin an tawh biakna khut dim khat la-in, biaknatau tungah hal ding hi. Tua khit ah, amah in tui pen nupi nu dawnsak ding hi.

Samsiatna a tun tui pen nupi nu a kidawnsak ciangin, tua nu amahmah kininsakin a pasal tungah citak loin gamta ahih leh, tua tui pen ama sunga tumin nasa velval ding hi; a gil hong puak ding a, a phei hong theepin a ciing hong suak ding a, a mipihte lakah a kisamsia mi ahi ding hi.
Ahih hangin nupi nu pen amahmah kininsak loin, a siang ahih leh, amah a khial lo hi a, amah in ta nei thei ding hi.
Hih pen nupi khat in a pasal’ zi-a a om sungin, amah lampialin, amahmah a kinitsak cianga dingin upmawhna tawh kisai thukham,
ahih keileh mi khat in a zi a ummawhna lungsim nei-in a zi a upmawh cianga dingin thukham ahi hi. Siampipa in Yahweh mai-ah nupi nu dingsak ding a, hih thukham khempeuh nupi nu’ tungah zang ding hi.
Tua ciangin khialhna bawlna khatpeuh panin a pasal mawhpeng ding a, ahih hangin nupi nu a mawh leh ama mawhna thuak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Pasal khat ahih keileh numei khat in a tuam vilvel kiciamna, Nazir mi kiciamna bangin Yahweh tungah kikhenkhiatna a kiciam nop ciangin,

amah pen leenggahzu ahi a, adang a kham theih zu ahi zongin kidek ding a, leenggahzu ahi a adang khamtheihzu khatpeuh pan ahi zongin a kibawl tuithuk dawn peuhmah lo ding hi. Amah in leenggahzu ahi a, leenggah hing ahi a, leenggah keu ahi zongin ne peuhmah lo ding hi.
Nazir mite bangin amah a kituamkoih hun tengin, leenggui pana piang bangmah ne lo ding a, a tang ahi a, a hawngte nangawn ahi zongin ne lo ding hi.

Tuam om dingin a kiciam hun sungtengin, ama lu tungah mulkiatna a kitah kei ding hi. Yahweh aa dingin a tuam om hun a bei mateng amah a siangtho hi pelmawh ding a, amah in a lu panin a khang a samte tua bangin koih pelmawh ding hi.
Yahweh aa dingin a tuam om hun sung tawntung, misi luang khatpeuh nai neh peuhmah lo ding hi.

A pa ahi a, a nu ahi a, a sanggampa ahi a, a sanggamnu nangawn ahi zongin a sih leh, amaute hangin amahmah kininsak peuhmah lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aa dingin a kituamkoihna ama lutungah om hi.
A kituam koih nite khempeuh sungin Yahweh aa dingin amah a siangtho ahi ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh a gei ah si vatin, amah in a ki-ap ama sam a nitsak leh, amah in a kisiansuah ni-in a lu mettol pelmawh ding hi. A ni sagih ni-in amah in mettol ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin a ni giat ni-in amah in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna, siampipa kiangah vakhu nih ahih keileh kawl vakhuno nih paipih ding hi.

Siampipa in khat pen mawhna hanga biakna-in, adang khat pen ama aa dingin mawhkhuhna a bawlsak nadingin meihal biakna-in pia ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh misi luang kiangah a omna hangin a mawh hi a, tua ni mahin amah in a lutang a siangtho-in a ap ding hi.

A tuam om ding hun sungteng Yahweh aa dingin ki-ap pelmawh ding a, gamtat khialhna hanga biakna-in kum khat a pha tuu apa khat paipih pelmawh ding hi. A masa hun teng pen a mawkna suak ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh a tuam om hun sungin amah a kininsak a suak hi.
Tu-in hih pen a tuam om hun a cin ciangin zuih ding Nazir Thukham ahi hi: Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah amah kipaipih ding a,

tua lai mun ah amah in Yahweh tungah citpiakna ahi ama meihal biak nadingte pen a sitbaang lo kum khat a pha tuu apa khat, mawhna hanga biakna-in a sitbaang lo kum khat a pha tuu anu khat, kilemna biakna-in a sitbaang lo tuutal khat,
silngo sawh loh anlum lawh khat, sathau tawh a kibawl annel mohte, sathau a kizuut silngo sawh loh mohphengte, an tawh biakna leh dawna biaknate hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in Yahweh mai-ah tuate paipih ding a, mawhna hanga biakna leh meihal biakna pia ding hi.
Amah in Yahweh tungah silngo sawh loh anlum lawh khat tawh kilemna biakna piakna-in tuutal pia ding hi. Siampipa in an tawh biakna leh dawna biakna zong pia ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah Nazir mipa in a ki-ap a sam mettol hamtang ding hi. Amah in a ki-metsa a sam paipihin kilemna biakpiakna nuai-a a om mei sungah hal ding hi.
Nazir mipa in a ki-apna sam a kiat siang khit ciangin, siampipa in a kihuansa tuutal liang, leh lawh sung panin silngo sawh loh moh khat, leh silngo sawh loh mohpheng khat mipa khut sungah koihin,

Yahweh mai-ah vei-a biakna-in siampipa in tuate vei ding hi. Tuate pen vei-a biakna awmsa leh lamto-a biakna pheisa tawh siampipa aa dingin a siangtho ahi hi. Tua khit ciangin Nazir mipa in leenggahzu dawn thei ding hi.

Hih pen ama zektan tawh kisai-a ama piak zawh zah a piak banah amah tuam om ding thukimna tawh Yahweh tungah ama biakna kiciamna a la Nazir mipa aa dingin Thukham ahi hi. Nazir mi’ Thukham tawh kizui-in, amah in a kiciamsa tangtungsak hamtang ding hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Aaron leh a tapate kiangah hih bangin genin, ‘Hih pen Israyl mite thupha na piak dan ding uh ahi hi. Amaute tungah:
‘YAHWEH IN NOTE THUPHA HONG PIA-IN HONG KEM HI.
YAHWEH IN NOTE TUNGAH A MAIPHA HONG TAANGSAK HENLA, HONG HEHPIH TAHEN.
YAHWEH IN NOTE MAIPHA HONG PIA HENLA, NOPSAKNA HONG PIA TAHEN,’ ci-in thupha pia uh hen.
Tua ahih manin Israyl mite tungah amaute in KA MIN koih ding uh a, Keimah in amaute thupha ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh in biakbuk a dinsak khit ciangin, amah in biakbuk leh a nazatte khempeuh sathau nilhin apin a siangthosak hi. Amah in biaknatau leh a nazatte khempeuh zong sathau a nilh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Israyl makaite, a kisim mite a uk minam makai ahi tua innkuan lutangte in biaknate a pia uh hi.
Makai khat ciat panin bawngtal khat ta leh makai nih ciangin leeng khat ta, amaute in buk a nei leeng guk leh bawngtal sawm-le-nih Yahweh mai-ah paipih uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Kikhopna Puanbuk nasep na ah zat dingin amaute tung panin tuate sang inla, Levi mite tungah a nasep ciat-a a kisapna tawh kizui-in pia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in leengte leh bawngtalte la-in, Levi mite tungah a pia hi.
Amah in Gershon’ suante tungah amau nasepna-a a kisapna tawh kizui-in leeng nih leh bawngtal li a pia hi.
Amah in siampi Aaron tapa Ithamar’ khut nuai-a om Merari’ suante tungah amau nasepna-a a kisapna tawh kizui-in leeng li leh bawngtal giat a pia hi.
Ahih hangin Kohath’ suante tungah amah in bangmah pia lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute vaipuak pen a siangtho nate a liangko tungah puak ding ahi hi.
Biaknatau sathau a kinilh ciangin, makaite in a ki-ap nadingun amau biaknate uh paipih uh a, biaknatau mai-ah tuate a pia uh hi.
Ahang in Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Biaknatau ap nadingin makai khat in ni khat ciat ta a biakna uh paipih ding hi.
Ni masa ni-in biakna a pia pen Yahdah minam panin Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon ahi hi.

A biakpiakna pen munsiangtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel 130 a gik ngun kuangdai khat leh shekel 70 a gik ngun tawh a kibawl thehna kuangkuum khat, an tawh biakna-in sathau tawh a kipawi annel limci tawh a kidim tuak hi a,
shekel sawm a gik kham sikkeu kuum khat, gim namtui a dim tawh;
meihal biakna dingin bawngtalno khat, tuutal khat, kum khat a pha tuuno apa khat,
mawhna hanga biakna-in keeltal khat,
kilemna biakna-in a kipia dingin bawngtal nih, tuutal nga, keeltal nga leh kum khat a pha tuuno apa nga ahi hi. Hihte pen Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon’ biakna ahi hi.
A ni nihna ni-in Issachar’ makaipa, Zuar’ tapa Nethaneel in a biakna paipih hi.

Yahweh tawh kiho dingin Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Mosheh a lut ciangin, amah in cherub nihte kikal, Thuciamna singkuang tunga om hehpihna tokhom tungsan teng panin amah a hopih Khat’ awging a za hi. Tua bang danin Yahweh in Mosheh a hopih hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Aaron hopih inla, ama kiangah, ‘Meivakte na vak ciangin, meivak sagihte in meivakkhuam mai teng a taan ding vak in,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Aaron in tua bangin a hih hi. Yahweh in Mosheh thu a piak bangin amah in meivakkhuam mai lam ngatin meivakte a gual hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Israyl mite lak panin Levi mite lakhia inla, amaute a ngeina bangin siangsak in.

Amaute siansak nadingin hih bangin na hih ding hi: siansakna tui amaute’ tungah theh inla, tua khit ciangin a pum tunga mul khempeuh amau kiatsak inla a puansilhte uh sawpin, tua ahih manin amau mah a kisiangsak tawm ding uh hi.
Sathau tawh a kipawi annel limci an-a biakna tawh bawngtal no khat amaute na lasak ding a, tua khit ciangin nangmah in mawhna hanga biakna-in bawngtalno adang khat na la ding hi.
Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah Levi mite paipihin, nangmah in Israyl mihon buppi na khawm ding hi.
Nangmah in Yahweh mai-ah Levi mite na paipih ding a, Levi mite tungah Israyl mite in a khut uh nga ding uh hi.
Aaron in Israyl mite sung panin vei-a biakna in Yahweh mai-ah Levi mite pia ding hi. Tua hileh Yahweh’ nasep a sem ding leh a bawl dingin amaute a kigingsa ahi pah ding uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Levi mite in bawngtalno tungah a khutte uh nga ding uh a, Levi mite aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawl nadingin khat pen Yahweh tungah mawhna hanga biakna-in leh adang khat pen meihal biakna dingin na zang ding hi.
Nangmah in tua khit ciangin Aaron leh a tapate’ mai-ah Levi mite na dingsak ding a, tua ciangin Yahweh tungah vei-a biakna-in amaute na pia ding hi.
Hih bang danin Israyl mite lak panin Levi mite khenin na tuam koih ding a, Levi mite pen Kei aa ding ahi uh hi.
Nangmah in Levi mite siangsakin vei-a biakna-in na piakkhit ciangin, amau’ nasep a sem dingin Kikhopna Puanbuk ah hong pai ding uh hi.
Amaute pen Kei’ tungah hong kipumpiak sitset Israyl mite ahi uh hi. Keimah in Israyl mi khempeuh’ tacil ahi naubu a hong khempeuh’ taang dingin Keima aa-in amaute ka lakhin hi.
Israyl sunga tacil peuhmah mihing ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin Keima aa ahi hi. Egypt gam sunga tacil khempeuh ka vatmai ciangin, Keima aa dingin amaute ka tuamkoih hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl mi tacil khempeuh taang dingin Levi mite ka lakhin a,

Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Israyl mite aa dingin na a sem ding leh munsiangtho nai-ah a pai uh ciangin pulnatna in Israyl mite a vatmang loh nadingin Israyl mite taangin mawhkhuhna a bawlsak dingin Israyl mite lak panin Aaron leh a tapate tungah citpiakna-in Levi mite ka piakhin hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Levi mite tawh kisai-in Mosheh thu a piak bangin Mosheh, Aaron leh Israyl mihon khempeuh in Levi mite tungah a hih uh hi. Tua bangin Israyl mite in amaute tungah hih uh hi.

Levi mite amau mahmah kisiansuahin a puansilhte uh a sawp uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Aaron in Yahweh mai-ah vei-a biakna-in amaute pia a, amaute a siangsak dingin amaute aa dingin mawhkhuhna a bawlsak hi.

Tua khit ciangin Aaron leh a tapate ukna nuai ah Kikhopna Puanbuk-a amau’ nasepte a sem a bawl dingin Levi mite a pai uh hi. Yahweh in Levi mite tawh kisai-in Mosheh thu a piak bangin amaute in Levi mite tungah a hih uh hi.

“Hih pen Levi mite tawh a kisai thu ahi hi: Kum sawmnih le nga pan a tungsiah a phate, Kikhopna Puanbuk-a nasepna sungah a kihel dingin hong pai ding uh a,

A kiseh hun, tu Kha ni Sawm le ni Li ni, nitak nih kikal, biakpiakna na pia pelmawh ding hi. A thukhamte leh a ngeina kipte khempeuh tawh kizui-in na bawl pelmawh ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

“Israyl mite kiangah gen in, ‘Misi luang lawnna hangin note khatpeuh hitaleh na suanlekhakte khatpeuh hitaleh a sianglo suakin ahih keileh khual gamla-a om ahih leh, amah in Yahweh’ Paisan Pawi biakna pia veve ding hi.

Biakbuk a kidinsak ni-in Tecipanna Puanbuk ahi biakbuk meii in tuam hi. Nitak-a kipan zingsang dong meikuang tawh kibangin biakbuk tungsan ah meii om hi.
Tua bangin kizomto-in om a, sunin meii in tuam a zanin mei tawh a kibang khat in tuam hi.
Puanbuk tungsan panin meii a kilaptoh peuhpeuh ciangin Israyl mite a dingkhia uh hi. Meii a kiphuh peuhpeuh ciangin Israyl mite in giahphual sat uh hi.
Yahweh’ thupiak bang lianin Israyl mite dingkhia uh a, Yahweh’ thupiak bang lianin Israyl mite in giahphual sat uh hi. Biakbuk tungsan ah meii a khawl laiteng, amaute giahphual ah omlai uh hi.
Biakbuk tungsan ah sauveipi meii a om nangawn ciangin zong, Israyl mite in Yahweh’ hilhna leh a sawlna mang uh a, dingkhia tuan lo uh hi.

Yahweh’ thupiakna bang lianin amaute in giahphual sat uh a, Yahweh’ thupiakna bang lianin amaute dingkhia uh hi. Mosheh tungtawnin Yahweh’ thupiakna tawh kituakin Yahweh’ hilhna mang uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“A kiseek ngun tawh ngun peengkul nih bawl inla, mihonte khop nading leh giahphual mainawtin suankhiat nadingin zang in.
Ngun peengkulte a nih tuakin a kiginsak; Teki’ah, saupi awi-in a ginsuak, ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna nangma mai-ah mihon buppi a kituah khawm ding uh hi.
Ngun peengkul khat bek a kiginsak: Teki’ah, ciangin, Israyl beh lutangte ahi makaite bek nangma mai-ah hong kikaikhawm ding uh hi.

Mihon a kituah khop ding ciangin, nangmah in Teki’ah na mut ding a, ahih hangin Teruah na gingsak kei ding hi.
Siampi Aaron’ tapate in peengkulte tum ding uh hi. Hih pen na khangkhangun note aa dingin a kip den tawntung thukham khat hi ding hi.

Na gam sung uhah, note hong nengniam na galte uh tawh na kido ding uh ciangin, note in hih peengkulte tawh zaksakna na gingsak ding uh a, Yahweh note Pa in note hong phawkin na galte kiang panin note hong honkhia ding hi.

Na lungdam kipak hun sung, a kisehsa na Pawi hunte sung, na Khadet pawite ah na meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate na piak hun ciangin zong note in zaksakna peengkulte na tum ding uh hi. Tua pen Yahweh note Pa’ mai-ah phawkna mualsuang khat hi ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh note Vantung Pa ka hi hi.
A kum nihna, a kha nihna, a ni sawmnih ni-in Tecipanna biakbuk tungsan panin meii kilakhia to hi.
Tua tak ciangin Sinai Sehnel gam panin Israyl mite dingkhia-in Paran Sehnel gam sungah meii a khawl mateng a pai uh hi.

Orcran’ tapa Pagiel pen Asher minam pawl a ukpa hi a,

Tu-in Mosheh in a sungpa ahi Midian mi Reuel’ tapa zong ahi a zi sanggampa Hobab kiangah a gen inah, “Yahweh in, ‘Keimah in tua gam note kong pia ding hi,’ ci-in a genna mun a zuan ka hi uh hi. Kote tawh hong pai in, nang kong limbawl ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Israyl tungah thupha lianpite hong ciamkhin zo hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in Mosheh kiangah, “Kong pai kei ding a, ka behte kiang ka gam mahmah ah ka ciahkik ding hi,” a ci hi.

Giahphual panin amaute a dinkhiat uh ciangin sunin amaute’ tungsan ah Yahweh’ meii a om hi.
Singkuang a dinkhiat peuh ciangin Mosheh in, ‘Dingto in, Yahweh aw! Na galte kithehthangsak inla, Nang hong mudahte Na mai panin taimangsak in,” a ci hi.
Singkuang a khawl peuh ciangin amah in, “Yahweh aw, Israyl tul tampi a honpite kiangah hong ciahkik in,” a ci hi.
Tu-in mite in amau’ tuahsiatna hangin Yahweh’ zakin phun uh a, tua in Amah lungkim losak hi; a heh suak hi. Tua ahih manin amaute lakah Yahweh’ mei kuangin, giahphual nawl kimkhat kangtum hi.
Mosheh kiangah mite a kiko uh ciangin, amah in Yahweh tungah thugen a, mei a mit hi.
Tua ahih manin tua mun pen Taberah a kici hi; tua pen, Kuang a cihna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh kiang panin amaute lakah mei a kuangzo hi.
Amaute tawh a mihon om khawm kihelziaute in anlim nget ngaungau ding kipan uh a, Israyl mite zong tau-in, “Sa nek ding nei hi leeng maw!
Egypt gam sungah man pia loin i nek ngasate, tangmaite, dawnpawlte, lothang neute, lothang sante, leh lothang kangte i phawkphawk hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in i ankam zong lim nawn lo hi. Hih manna simloh bangmah dang om peuhmah lo hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tu-in manna pen nannan tang tawh a kibang hi a, a mel pen bedolak singnai tawh kibangin a kang ahi hi.
Mite pai kawikawi-in khawm uh a, an gawina tawh gawi-in, tua ahih keileh sum sungah su-in, beelin huan uh a, mohin a bawl uh hi; A limna pen olive sathau tawh a kibawl moh ki-em tawh kibang hi.

Tua ahih manin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Bang hangin na nasempa hong hici bawlsiat na hi hiam? Hih mite khempeuh vangikin kei tungah nong suat nadingin Na lungkim loh nadingin bang hong bawl ka hi hiam?

Keimah in hih mite khempeuh paii ka hi hiam? Amaute ka ta sa na hi hiam? Naucingnu in naungek a puak bangin amaute ka angah pua-in a pu a pate uh tungah Na ciamsa leitang ah a paipih dingin bang hangin hong gen na hi hiam?

Kei tungah nong bawl sawmna hih bang ahih leh, tu mahmah kei hong that in; Na mai-ah maipha ka muh ahih leh, ka lametna leh ka hahkatnate a tangtun lohna hong musak kei in,” a ci hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Mite laka makaite leh ulian-a na theih Israyl upa mi 70-te khawmin Ka kiangah hong paipih in. Nangmah tawh amaute a dinkhop theih nadingin, Kikhopna Puanbuk ah amaute paisak in.

Tua lai mun ah Kei hong paisukin nang tawh i kiho ding a, Keimah in nang tunga om Kha la-in, tua Kha mah amaute tungah Ka koih ding a, nang guak in na puak loh nadingin amaute in nangmah tawh mite’ tavuan hong puak pih ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin nangmah in mite kiangah, ‘Zingcianga dingin note ki-apin kisiangtho tawmsak un, note in sa na ne ding uh hi. Note in, ‘Sa nek ding nei hi leeng maw! Egypt pan i paikhiat buangin!’ ci-in na tau na uh, Yahweh in hong za hi. Tu-in Yahweh in note sa hong pia ding a, na ne ding uh hi.
Note in ni khat sung, ahih keileh ni nih sung, ahih keileh ni nga sung, ahih keileh ni sawm sung, ahih keileh ni sawm nih sung bek ne loin,

kha khat bup na ne ding uh hi! Na ikkhiat dong uhleh na kih dong matengun na ne ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh note in note laka om Yahweh na nial uh a, Ama mai-ah, ‘Bang hangin Egypt nusia i hi hiam?’ ci-in na tau uh hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Hih lai-ah pasal 600,000(tul zaguk) lakah ka om a, Nangmah in, ‘Kha khat bup a nek ding uh sa amaute ka pia ding hi,’ na ci hi.
Amaute khamzah dingin tuuhonte leh bawnghonte amau aa dingin kigozo ding ahi hiam? Tua ahih keileh tuipi ngasate khempeuh amau khamzah ding kimanzo ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh dawng a, “Yahweh’ hih theihna kiciangtan ahi hiam?* Ka thugen nang aa dingin hong tangtung hiam tangtung lo hiam cih na mu ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh paikhia-in Yahweh’ kammalte mite gen hi; Amah in mite’ upa 70-te kaikhawmin, puanbuk kiimkot ah a omsak hi.

Tua khit ciangin meii sungah Yahweh hong paisukin amah hopih a, ama tunga om Kha la-in, tua Kha mah upa 70-te tungah a koih hi. Amaute tungah Kha a om ciangin, amaute in kamsang uh a, khawl loin gen suak uh hi.

Ahih zongin mi nih min pen Eldad leh Medad hi a, giahphual sungah a omlai uh hi. Amau tenih pen upate laka kihel hi a, ahih hangin puanbuk ah pai lo uh hi. Amau tungah zong Kha om ahih manin, giahphual sungah kam a sang uh hi.
Tangval no khat hong tai-in Mosheh kiangah gen a, “Eldad leh Medad in giahphual sungah kamsang uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin a khangno huna kipan Mosheh a huh, Nun’ tapa Yahshua in, “Ka Makaipa, Mosheh aw, amaute khawlsak in!” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in ama kiangah, “Keima tangin hong hazatsak na hi hiam? Yahweh’ mite khempeuh kamsang hi henla, amaute tungah Ama Kha koih leh maw!” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh leh Israyl upate giahphual ah a ciahkik uh hi.

Tu-in Yahweh kiang panin huih hong nungkhia-in, tuipi panin vamimte hong mutgawp hi. Tuate pen giahphual kiimkot khempeuh ah leilak panin pi thum bang a sahin ni khat bang lampai na ding tan mun khempeuh ah a kia hi.

Tua sun tawntung leh a zan tawntung leh zingsang tawntungin mite dingin vamimte a khawm uh hi. Omer sawm(Beem sawm kiim) sangin a tawmzaw a tawm kuamah om lo hi. Tua khit ciangin amaute in giahphual kiimkot khempeuh ah a keusak dingin nisa ah a pho-in a zalh uh hi.
Ahih hangin sa a kigaih ma, amau’ ha kawmah sa a baang laipi mahin, mite tungah Yahweh’ hehna hong tho a, Yahweh in pulnatna lianpi khat tawh mite a vatgawp hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in tua mun pen Kibroth Hattaavah ci-in min a vawh hi. A khiatna pen Lunggulhna Hankhukte a cihna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tua lai mun ah sa a lunggulh mite a vui uh hi.
Kibroth Hattaavah panin mite Hazeroth ah pai uh a, Hazeroth ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Mosheh in Ethiopian numei a tenpihna hangin Miriam leh Aaron in Mosheh a gensia uh hi.
Amaute in, “Yahweh in Mosheh tungtawn bekin thugen hilo ahi hiam? Eite tungtawnin zong Amah in thu hong genkhin hilo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Yahweh in tua thu a za hi.
(Tu-in hih mipa Mosheh pen a kiniamkhiat mahmah mi hi a, leitung maitanga om mi khempeuh sangin kiniamkhiatzaw hi.)
Thakhatthu-in Yahweh in Mosheh, Aaron leh Miriam kiangah, “Kikhopna Puanbuk ah na thumun hong pai un!” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amau teng thum pai uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin meii khuampi sungah Yahweh hong tuaksukin Puanbuk kongkhak ah ding a, Aaron leh Miriam a sam hi. Amau tegel a mailam nehin hong pai uh a,
tua ciangin Amah in, “Tu-in Ka kammalte za un: note lakah kamsang a om leh, Keimah, Yahweh in maangmuhnate tawh ama tungah ka lak a, mang sungah Keimah in amah ka hopih hi.
Ka nasempa Mosheh tawh kisai-in tua bang hi lo hi. Amah pen Ka Inn sung khempeuh ah a citakpa ahi hi.

Keimah in amah tawh kimaingatin ka hopih a, a kitel lo thugennate bang hi loin a kitel sitsetin ka hopih hi; amah in Yahweh’ duangsuah a mu hi. Tua hi napi-in bang hangin Ka nasempa Mosheh gensiat ding lau lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute tungah Yahweh’ hehna lian mahmah a, Amah a paikhia hi.
Biakbuk tungsan panin meii a paikhiat ciangin, Miriam pen thakhatthu-in phak a, vuk bangin a pak hi. Miriam lamah Aaron kihei phei a, amah a phakkhitna a mu hi;
Amah in Mosheh kiangah, “Ka sanggampa aw! Kote hai gamtat mahmahin ka mawhna uh hehpihna tawh kote langah lenkip kei in.
A nu sung panin a suahkhiat ciangin a pum phel langkhat a bei a sisa-a suak naungek bangin Miriam hisak kei tapeuh ta in!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh tungah Mosheh kiko a, a gen inah, “Hehpihna tawh amah damsak in, Yahweh aw, thu kong ngen hi!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “A pa in tua numei’ maitang cil phih leh, ni sagih sung tua numei maizum ding hi lo ahi hiam? Giahphual pualam ah ni sagih sung kikhumcipsak in; tua khit ciangin amah hong kipaipihkik thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin ni sagih sung giahphual pualam ah Miriam kikhumcip hi; amah a kipaipihkik mateng mite in a khualzin lo uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Hazeroth panin mite dingkhia a, Paran Sehnel gam sungah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah: 2 “Israyl mite tungah ka piak ding Canaan gam a kan dingin mi sawl in. A pu apate uh minam khat ciat panin a makaite uh khat ciat sawl in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh’ thupiakna bang lianin, Paran Sehnel gam panin Mosheh in amaute sawlkhia hi. Amaute khempeuh pen Israyl mi makaite ahi uh hi.
Tu-in hihte pen amau’ minte ahi hi: Reuben minam panin Zaccur’ tapa Shammua,
Simeon minam panin Hori’ tapa Shaphat,
Yahdah minam panin Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb,
Issachar minam panin Yahseph’ tapa Igal,
Ephraim minam panin Nun’ tapa Hoshea; Yahshua,
Benyamin minam panin Raphu’ tapa Palti,
Zebulun minam panin Sodi’ tapa Gaddiel,
Yahseph minam ahi Menasheh minam panin Susi’ tapa Gaddi,
Dan minam panin Gemalli’ tapa Ammiel,
Asher minam panin Michael’ tapa Sethur,
Naphtali minam panin Vophsi’ tapa Nahbi,
Gad minam panin Machi’ tapa Geuel ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Mosheh in Canaan gam a vaan dingin a sawlkhiat mite min ahi hi. (Mosheh in Nun’ tapa Hoshea pen YAHSHUA cih min a pia hi.)
Mosheh in Canaan gam kan dingin amaute a sawlkhiat ciangin, amah in amaute kiangah, “Negev tawnin paito unla, mualtung gam ah pai un.
Leitang bangci hiam, tua leitanga a teng mite thahat hiam, thahat lo hiam, mi tawm hiam, tam hiam,
amau tenna leitang hoih hiam, sia hiam; amau omna khuapite giahphual hiam, mun muanhuai hiam,
a leitang a lei hoih hiam, lei sia hiam, sing om hiam om lo hiam, va en un. Na siam tawpin va hih un. Tua gama a gahte pawlkhat hong ciahpih un. Tu hun pen leenggah a palte a min hun ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute paito-in, Zin Sehnel gam panin Hamath khua lutna gei, Rehob dong gam a vaan uh hi.

Negev tawnin amaute pai to uh a; Ahiman mite, Sheshai mite, leh Talmai mite, Anak’ suanlekhakte tenna ahi Hebron ah tung uh hi. (Tu-in Hebron pen Egypt gam sunga Zoan a kisatma kum sagih lai-in a kisat khua ahi hi.)

Eshcol Kuam ah amaute a tun uh ciangin, amaute in a hiang khat tunga a om leenggah bawk khat bek amaute in satkhia uh hi. Tua pen mi nih in a kikalah zawl khat khung a zawng uh a, mangkawlsing leh thei tawmkhat tawh zong ahi hi.
Israyl’ suante in tua lai ah leenggah bawk a a lawhna uh hangin tua lai mun pen Eshcol(Singgah bawk ahih keileh a Bawk) Kuam kici hi.
Ni sawmli a cin lianin, a gam vaanna uh panin amaute hong ciahkik uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Paran Sehnel gam sung Kadesh-a om Mosheh leh Aaron, leh Israyl mi honpi khempeuh kiangah hong ciahkik uh hi. Amaute leh mihonpi khempeuh tungah thu puakkik uh a, tua gama a gahte amaute a lak uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in Mosheh kiangah, “Kote nong sawlna gam ah ka tung uh a, bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna gam taktak ahi hi. Hih pen tua gam gahte ahi hi.
Ahi zongin tua gama a teng mite thahat uh a, a khuapite uh muanhuai-in lian mahmah hi. Tua lai mun ah Anak’ suanlekhakte zong ka mu uh hi.
Negev gam sungah Amalek mite teng uh hi; Hit mite, Yebus mite, leh Amor mite pen mualtung gam ah teng uh a, Canaan mite pen tuipi gei leh Yardan gun dung ah teng uh hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Caleb in Mosheh mai-a tua mite daisak a, “Thakhatin paito-in va luah ni, bang hang hiam cihleh i hih zo mahmah ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah tawh a paito mite in, “Tua mite a do dingin eite i hi thei kei hi! Eite sangin amaute thahatzaw uh hi!” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute in amau’ vaansa gam thu Israyl mite tungah a sia lamin hong puak uh a, “A vaan dingin kote ka va pai na uh gam in a gam sunga teng mite a puksisak hi. Tua lai muna ka muh uh mite khempeuh pen lian thei mahmah uh hi.
Kote in tua lai mun ah Nephilim mite (Nephilim pana piang Anak’ suanlekhakte) ka mu uh hi. Kote kauphe bang lelin ka kingaihsun uh a, amaute muhna ah zong tua bangmah ka hi takpi uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin mihon khempeuh nakpitakin a aw uh sangsakin tua zan a kap uh hi.
Israyl mite khempeuh in Mosheh leh Aaron phunsan uh a, mihon buppi in amaute kiangah, “Egypt gam sungah ahi a, hih gamlak ah ahi zongin sizaw ta hoh leng!

Namsau tawh a si ding bek lelin Yahweh in bang hangin hih gam ah hong paipih ahi hiam? Ka zite leh ka tate uh hong kisuh mangsak ding hi. Eite aa dingin Egypt ah kilehkik leng hoih zaw ding hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute khatlekhat in, “Eite in makai khat i teel ding a, Egypt ah i ciahkik ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua lai muna Israyl mihon kikhawmte khempeuh mai-ah Mosheh leh Aaron a mai uh kunsuk a,
gam a vaan mite laka Nun’ tapa Yahshua leh Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb in a puansilhte uh a balkek uh hi;
Amaute in Israyl mihon khempeuh tungah, “Ka vatotna gam leh ka kankhiat uh gam pen a nak hoih mahmah gam ahi hi.
Yahweh in eite hong lungkim pih leh, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luanna tua gam sungah Amah in hong mapi ding a, Amah in eite tungah hong pia ding hi.

Yahweh lang pan kei bek unla, tua mite lau kei un. Amaute pen i nawmvalh mang dingte hi lel uh hi. A kidalna un nusia khin hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Yahweh pen eite tawh hong om khawm hi. Amaute kihta kei un,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin mihon buppi in amaute suang tawh denlup dingin gen uh hi. Tua tak ciangin Israyl mi khempeuh mai, Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Yahweh’ minthanna vang hong kilang a,
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Hih mite in bang tanvei Kei hong nial ding uh ahi hiam? Amaute laka ka bawlsa hih limte khempeuh om napi-in amaute in bang tanvei Kei hong um lo lailai ding uh ahi hiam?
Keimah in amaute pulnatna tawh ka vattukin amaute gamluah ka hisak nawn kei ding a, amaute sangin a lianzaw leh a thahatzaw minamin nang kong bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Tua hileh Egypt mite in hih thu za ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute lak panin nangmah in Na hatna, Na thahatna, Na thuneihna tawh hih mite na paikhiatpih hi.

Amaute in hih gama teng mite tungah gen ding uh hi. Yahweh aw, nangmah hih mite tawh na omna thu leh amaute tungsan ah Na meii khawlin sunin meii khuam, zanin mei khuam tawh amaute mai-ah na pai na tawh na kimaituahpihna thu amaute in za khin uh hi.
Tu-in hih mite mihing khat thah bangin that hi lecin, Nangma minthanna a zasa minamte in Nangma’ thu genin,
‘Yahweh in kiciamna tawh amaute tunga a ciamsa gam sungah hih mite paipih zo lo ahih manin Amah in gamlak ah amaute that hi,’ ci ding uh hi.
Tu-in Yahweh’ thuneihna hong lakkhia in, Nangmah in nong genkhitsa hih bang lianin:

‘Yahweh hehhak a, a itna kip lianin, gamtatsiatna leh thu palsatna; Na Thukhamte zuih lohna, maisak a, ahih hangin a mawhtena mawk khah ngei kei hi. Pate’ nu-le-pa mawhna hangin a piang natnate tate tungah omin, khang thum khang lina dongin a kithei dingin Amah in bawl ding hi,’ na ci hi.
Egypt panin ka paikhiat uha kipanin a lian Nangma hehpihna tawh na maisaksa mah bangin hih mite’ gamtatsiatna maisak in, kong thuum hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Nangma nong nget mah bangin amaute ka maisakkhin hi.
Ahih hangin Kei a nungta taktak ka hih mah bangin Yahweh’ minthanna vang in leitung buppi dim taktak ding hi.
Ka minthanna vang, Egypt gam sung leh gamlaka ka bawl lim lamdangte mukhin napi ahih hangin Ka thu hong mang loin, sawm vei kei hong ze-et mi peuhmah—
tua mi peuhmah in a pu a pate tungah kiciamna tawh ka ciam leitang mukha peuhmah lo ding a, Kei hong nial mi peuhmah in zong tua gam mukha lo ding uh hi!
Ahih hangin Ka nasempa Caleb in a sungah lungsim tuam nei-in Kei hong zui ahih manin amah in a zuat gam sungah ka paipih ding a, a suanlekhakte in tua gam luah ding uh hi.
Tu-in tua kuam sungte ah Amalek mite leh Canaan mite teng uh ahih manin, Tuipi San paina lampi tawnin zing ciangin gamlak lamah pai un,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron hopihin a gen inah:
7 Hih a gilo mihonte in bang tanvei Kei hong phunsan ding uh ahi hiam? Israyl mite in Kei hong phunsanin a kikona uh ka zakhin hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute kiangah, “Yahweh in, ‘Kei a nungta ka hih mah bangin note tauna ka zak nate bang tektekin note tungah kong hih ding hi.
Kei hong gensia note pumpi khempeuh hih gam sungah puk ding hi—Note khempeuh kum 20 pan a tungsiah mi kisimna sunga a kihelte leh hong phunsante peuhmah puk ding hi.
Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb leh Nun’ tapa Yahshua lobuang note a tengsak dingin ka kiciamna leitang ah note khat zong na lut kha kei ding uh hi.
Na tate uh ahih leh note in hong kisuh mangsak ding hi na ci uh a, Keimah in amaute paipihin, note in thusim loin na nial uh leitang amaute in ngah ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin note na hih uh leh, hih gamlak ah na si ding uh hi!
Na luanghawmte uh a nunung pen hih gamlak ah a kisial mateng, gamlak ah kum 40 sung na tate uh tuucing hi ding uh a, note cihtak lohna hanga natna amaute in thuak ding uh hi.
Na gam vaan sung uh ni 40 ah ni khat ciangin kum khat, kum 40 sung na mawhna hangun note in na thuak ding uh a, note tawh kisai-in Keima puahphatna Ka deihna bulpi na thei ding uh hi,’ Kong ci hi.

Keimah, Yahweh in, ‘Keimah langpangin a kikaikhawm hih a gilo mihonpi tungah hih nate ka hih taktak ding hi. Amaute in hih gamlak ah amaute’ beina tuak ding uh a, hih lai mun ah amaute kivui ding hi!’ Kong ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in gam vaan dingin a sawl mite hong ciahkikin gam thu tawh kisai-in a sialamin genna tawh mihon buppi amah a phunsansak,
tua gam kisiagawp hi ci-in a sialamin thu a genthang hih mite Yahweh mai-ah pulnatna hangin si uh hi.
Gam vaan dingin a pai mi khempeuh panin Nun’ tapa Yahshua leh Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb bek a hing lai uh hi.
Mosheh in hih kammalte khempeuh Israyl mi khempeuh tungah a gen ciangin, mipite nakpi takin dahin kap uh hi.
A zingciang zingsang tuungin amaute kilehkikin, mual sang dawn gam lamah pai uh a, “Hih lai-ah eite i om hi, Yahweh in hong ciamsa mun ah i pai ding hi! Eite i mawhkhin hi!” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in, “Bang hangin Yahweh’ thupiakna palsatin leitaw lamah kihei sawm na hi uh hiam? Hih pen tangtung lo ding hi.
Note kahto kei un, bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in eite hong ompih lo hi. Na galte un note hong zo gawp ding a,

ahang in Amalek mite leh Canaan mite note langah pang ding uh a, namsau tawh note na si ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh kiang panin note na pialkhia uh a, Yahweh in note hong ompih lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Mosheh hitaleh Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang hitaleh giahphual panin dingkhia lo napi-in gamlak mual dawnah kuantoh ding amaute in ngaihsun veve uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua mual dawn gama teng Amalek mite leh Canaan mite hong paisuk uh a, Hormah ciang dong nangawnah amaute lehhawlin amaute a zo uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Na tenna dingun note kong piak gam sungah na tun uh ciangin,

Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui, meihal biaknate ahih keileh a tuam vilvel kiciamna aa dingin biakpiakna ahi a, uttawmna hanga biaknate ahi a, a ngeina bangin a omsa na Pawite uh-a biaknate ahi zongin na piak uh ciangin bawnghon pan ahi a, tuuhon pan ahi zongin mei tawh kihal biaknate Yahweh tungah na pia ding uh hi.
Ama biakna a paipih mipa in sathau hin khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat tawh a kipawi annel limci ephah seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat ahi an tawh biakna zong Yahweh tungah pia ding hi.
Meihal biakna ahih keileh biakpiak nadingin tuuno khat tawh leenggahzu hin khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat zong na bawl ding hi.
Sathau hin khat seh-thum-suah-seh-khat tawh a kipawi annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-nih, tuutal tawh na bawlkhol ding a,
dawna biakna-in leenggahzu hin khat seh-thum-suah-seh-khat zong hi ding hi. Hihte pen Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in pia in.
Meihal biakna ahih keileh a tuam vilvel kiciamna dinga biakpiakna ahih keileh kilemna biakna-in Yahweh tungah bawngtalno khat na bawl uh ciangin,
sathau hin lang tawh a kipawi annel limci ephah seh-sawm-suah-seh-thum tawh a kibawl an tawh biakna tawh bawngtal khat ciat na paipih ding uh hi.
Dawna biakna-in leenggahzu hin lang zong na paipih ding hi. Hih pen Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in mei tawh a kihal biakna hi ding hi.
Bawngtal ahih keileh tuutal khat ciat, tuuno ahih keileh keelno khat ciat, tua bang dan tawh kizui-in na bawl ding uh ahi hi.
Na biakpiakna uh a tam hangin zong khat ciat biakna aa dingin tua bangin bawl in.
A lungkimhuai gim namtui-in mei tawh kihal Yahweh tungah biakna amah in a paipih ciangin, tualsung mi khempeuh in hih nate tu-a bangin hih hamtang ding uh hi.

Peemta ahih keileh na khang tawntungun note lakah hong om mi khatpeuh in Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in mei tawh kihal biakna a piak peuhpeuh ciangin amah in note bawl bangin bawl hamtang ding hi.
Mihonpi aa dingin leh note hong peem khualmi aa dingin na khang tawntungun a kip den tawntung thukham dingin thukham Khat hi ding hi. Yahweh mai-ah peemtate zong note bangmah ahi hi.
Note leh note tawh a om peemtate aa dingin Thukham khat leh ngeina khat ahi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:

“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Note Kong paipihna gam sungah tungin, Ciamna Gam’ leitang tung ah na lut phet, tua lai mun ah na galte uh na hawlkek gawp ma, nuamtakin na ten ma nangawnin,
tua gam-a a gahte na nek uh ciangin Yahweh tungah biakna-in sehtanh khat na pia ding uh hi; terumah; tua pen munsiangtho-a a kisapnate aa dingin a kikhenkhia ahi hi.
