Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah a gen inah:

“Hih pen Yahweh in a thupiaksa Thukham ngeina khat ahi hi: Israyl mite kiangah gen inla, Poina nei loin a sitbaang lo, a tungah nasepna kol a kivawh ngei nai lo, geelna khatpeuh aa dinga a kizang ngei nai vet lo, bawngla a san khat nomau kiangah hong paipih na dingin gen un.
Tua pen siampi Eleazar kiangah pia unla, tua pen giahphual pualam ah kipaipih ding a, ama mai-ah kigo ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampi Eleazar in a khutme tawh a sisan kimkhat la-in Kikhopna Puanbuk mailam ah a sisan sagih vei theh ding hi.
Ama et sungin, tua bawngla ama muhna ah kihal ding hi. A vun, a sa, a sisan, leh a ek kihal ding hi.
Siampipa in taamtak sing leh puknah leh samul khau san la ding a, a kihal bawngla tungah hal ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in a puansilhte sawpin tui tawh kipumsil pelmawh ding hi. Nitum mateng amah pen ngeina bangin a siang lo hi ding a, tua khit ciangin giahphual sungah tum thei pan ding hi.
Bawngla a hal mipa in a puansilhte sawpin, tui sungah kipumsil pelmawh ding a, nitum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.

Tua ciangin a siang mi khat in a San Bawngla’ vute khawm ding a, giahphual pualam ngeina bangin a siang mun khat ah koih ding hi. Siantho lohna panin siansakna tui ah zat dingin Israyl mihon khempeuh aa dingin tuate kikem ding hi. Tua pen mawhna panin siansuah nading ahi hi.

A San Bawngla’ vute a khawm mipa in zong a puansilhte sawp ding a, amah zong nitum mateng a siang lo hi ding hi. Tua pen Israyl mite leh amaute laka a peem khualmite aa dingin a kip tawntung ngeina khat ahi ding hi.
Misi luang khatpeuh a lawng mipa ni sagih sung a siang lo hi ding hi.

A ni thum ni leh a ni sagih ni-in a san bawngla’ tui tawh amahmah kisiansuah pelmawh ding hi; tua khit ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi. A zenzenin a ni thum ni leh a ni sagih ni-in amahmah a kisiansuah kei leh, amah a siang hi lo ding hi.

Misi luang khatpeuh lawngin amahmah a kisiansuah lo mi peuhmah in Yahweh’ biakbuk a thanghuaisak ahi hi. Israyl sung panin tua mipa kibeimangsak ding hi. Amah pen a siang lo hi lai ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ama tungah siansuahna tui kitheh lo hi. Ama siantho lohna a tungah a baang lai ahi hi.
Hih pen puanbuk sungah mi khatpeuh a sih ciangin zat ding Thukham ahi hi: tua puanbuk sungah a lutmi leh tua sungah a om mi peuhmah ni sagih sung a siang lo hi ding a,
kisiincip loin a kihong beel peuhmah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Namsau tawh gamlak ah a kithat mi ahi a, sih ngeina bangin a si khatpeuh ahi a, mi guh ahi a, han ahi zongin a lawng mi peuhmah ni sagih sung a siang lo hi ding hi.
A siang lo mipa aa dingin a kihal siansuah biakpiakna panin vut pawlkhat pen beel sung khat ah koihin, a tungah tui siang na sungsuk ding uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin a siang mi khat in puknah la-in tua siansuahna tui sungah diah ding a, puanbuk tung leh a nazat khempeuh tung leh tua lai-a a om mi khempeuh tungah theh ding hi. Mihing guh ahi a, a kithat mi khatpeuh han ahi a, sih ngeina banga a si mi khatpeuh a hi zongin a lawng mipa zong amah in theh ding hi.

A siang mipa in a ni thum ni leh a ni sagih ni-in a siang lo mipa theh ding a, a ni sagih ni-in amah siangsak ding hi. A siang khin phet mipa in a puansilhte sawpin tui tawh kipumsil pelmawh ding a, ni tum hun lian ah amah a siang hi ding hi.

Ahih hangin siang loin amahmah a kisiansuah lo mipa pen mihon lak panin kibeimangsak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Yahweh’ munsiangtho thanghuaisak a, siansakna tui pen ama tungah kitheh lo a, amah a siang lo ahi hi.
Hih pen amaute aa dingin tatsat lo ngeina khat ahi hi. Siansakna tui a theh mipa in a puansilhte sawp hamtang ding a, siansakna tui a lawng mi peuhmah nitum mateng a siang lo hi ding hi.
A siang lo mi khatpeuh in a lawn na khat peuhpeuh a siang lo suak a, a siang lo khat peuhpeuh a lawng peuhmah nitum mateng a siang lo a suak hi,” a ci hi.
A Kha Masa kha sungin, Zin Sehnel gam sungah Israyl mihon buppi tung uh a, Kadesh ah phual a sat uh hi. Tua lai-ah Miriam si a, tua lai mun mahah a kivui hi.
Tu-in mihonte aa dingin tui om lo a, Mosheh leh Aaron langa pang dingin mipite a kikhawm uh hi.
Amaute, Mosheh tawh kiselin kidem bawl uh a, “Yahweh mai-ah i sanggamte a sih lai-in kote zong a sikhin hizaw ta hoh le ung!
Hih mun ah kote leh ka gankhawite uh a si dingin bang hangin hih gamlak ah Yahweh’ mihonte hong paipih na hi hiam?
Bang hangin Egypt gam panin hih a lipkhaphuai mun ah kote hong paikhiatpih na hi hiam? An ahi a, thei ahi a, leenggui ahi a, mang kawlsing ahi zongin a omlohna mun hi a, dawn ding tui zong om lo hi!
Mihonte omna panin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah Mosheh leh Aaron pai uh a, amaute maikunsukin, Yahweh’ minthanna vang amaute tungah hong kilang hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah:

“Na ciangkhut la inla, nang leh na sanggampa Aaron in mihonte kaikhawm tuah un. Amaute in nang hong et laitakin, tua suangpi tungah thupia inla, tua suangpi in tui hong luangkhiasak ding hi. Mihonte aa dingin tua suangpi panin tui na tawikhia ding uh hi, tua ahih manin amaute leh a gankhawite in dawn thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in amah a thupiak bangin Mosheh in Yahweh’ mai panin a ciangkhut la hi.

Mosheh leh Aaron in tua suangpi mai-ah mihonte kaikhawm tuah hi. Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in amaute kiangah, “Tu-in za un, a lehdo mite aw! Note aa dingin hih suangpi pan tui kong phulkhiatsak loh uh phamawh ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in a khut laamto-in a ciangkhut tawh suangpi nih vei sat hi. Tui hong phulkhia buahbuah a, mihon khempeuh leh a gankhawite in dawn uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah, “Israyl mite muhna ah a Siangtho-in Kei nong pahtawi ding zahun hong muang loin hong umlo na hih manun, amaute ka piaksa gam sungah hih mihon, note in na paipih kei ding uh hi.
Hihte pen Israyl mite in Yahweh’ a selna mun leh amah in amaute lakah Amah a sianthona a kilahna mun Meribah-a tuite ahi hi; Meribah a khiatna pen Kiselna ahih keileh Kidem bawlna ahi hi.
Mosheh in Kadesh panin Edom kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawl a, “Hih pen na sanggam Israyl-te kong cih uh ahi hi: Kote’ tuahkhak haksatna khempeuh na thei uh hi.
Ka pu ka pate uh Egypt gam sungah paisuk uh a, kum tampi sung tua lai-ah teng uh hi. Egypt mite in kote leh ka pu ka pate uh hong gim bawl uh hi.
Yahweh tungah kote ka kiko uh ciangin Amah in kote kikona hong za-a, vantungmi hong sawlin, Egypt gam panin kote hong paikhiatpih hi. Tu-in kote nangma gam nawl Kadesh khuapi sungah ka om uh hi.

Hehpihna tawh na gam sung nawkin hong kantansak in. Kote in lo khatpeuh ahi a, leenggah lo khatpeuh ahi zongin ka nawk kei ding uh a, tuikhuk khatpeuh panin zong tui ka dawn kei ding uh hi. Kumpipa’ lamlian dungah ka pai ding uh a, na gam sung nawkin ka khen khit matengun taklam ahi a, vei lam ahi zongin ka pial kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Edom in amah dawng a, “Note in ka leitang na nawk kei ding uh hi. Nong nawk uhleh namsau tawh kote hong kuankhia-in kong do ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Israyl mite in ama kiangah, “Lamlian dung tawnin kote ka pai ding uh a, kote ka hi uh a, ka gankhawite ahi zongin na tui uh themkha ka dawnkhak uh leh, tua hangin a man kong pia ding uh hi. Kote in khe tawh nawkin a kantan nuam bek ka hi uh a, bangmah dang hi peuhmah lo hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in dawng kik leuleu a, “Nong nawk kei ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua tak ciangin amaute langah a thahat galkap tampitak tawh Edom-te hong kuankhia uh hi.
Edom in amau’ gam nawk dingin Israyl mite nial a hih manin ama kiang panin Israyl-te a kiheikhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl mihon buppi in Kadesh nusia-in Hor Mual ah a tung uh hi.
Edom gamgi nai-a Hor Mual ah Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron hopihin a gen inah:
Aaron pen ama mipihte kiangah kigawm ta ding hi. Israyl mite ka piak leitangah amah lut kha lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh no tegel in Meribah tuite-a Ka thupiakna nong nial uh hi.
Aaron leh a tapa Eleazar sam inla, Hor Mual ah paipihto in.
Aaron’ puante suahkhiatsak inla, a tapa Eleazar tungah silhsak in; bang hang hiam cihleh Aaron pen a mipihte kiangah a kigawm ding hi ta hi. Tua lai mun ah amah si ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh’ thupiak bang lianin Mosheh gamta a, mihon khempeuh muhin Hor Mual ah amaute paito uh hi.
Mosheh in Aaron tung panin a puante lakhia-in, a tapa Eleazar tungah a silhsak hi. Mual dawn tua lai mun ah Aaron a si hi. Tua khit ciangin mual tung panin Mosheh leh Eleazar paisuk uh hi.
Mihon khempeuh in Aaron a sih lam a theih uh ciangin, Aaron hangin Israyl innkuan khempeuh ni 30 sung a kap uh hi.
Negev gam sunga teng Canaan mi Arad kumpipa in Atharim lampaina lamdung tawnin Israyl-te a paina uh a zak ciangin, amah in Israyl mite do-in, amaute kimkhat salin a man hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl-te in Yahweh tungah hih kiciamna a bawl uh hi: Ka khutsung uh ah hih mite nong piak a hih nak leh, kote in amau’ khuapite ka susia maimang ding uh hi, a ci uh hi.

Yahweh in Israyl-te’ ngetna dawng a, amau’ khut sungah Canaan mite a pia hi. Israyl-te in amaute leh a khuapite uh susia maimang uh hi. Tua ahih manin tua mun min pen Hormah kici hi; a khiatna pen Suksiat Maimangna, a cihna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Hor Mual panin Edom gam kiim ah a pai dingin Tuipi San lam zuatna tawnin pai uh hi. Ahih hangin lam tawntung ah amaute lungduai loin,

Yahweh leh Mosheh gensia uh a, “Hih gamlak ah a si dingin Egypt gam panin bang hangin kote hong paikhiatpihto na hi hiam? Anlum lah om lo! Tui lah om lo! Hih a kihhuai an zong ka mudah uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in amaute lakah gul gupha-te sawl a, tuate in mite tu-in Israyl mi tampite a si uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Mosheh kiangah mite hong pai uh a, “Yahweh leh nang hong gensia ka hih manun ka mawh uh hi. Kote kiang panin Yahweh in gulte a lakkhiat nadingin hong thuumsak in,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin Mosheh in mite aa dingin a thuumsak hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Gul khat bawl inla, khuam khat tungah khai in; gul in a tuk mi tua a en peuhmah nungta ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in sumngo gul khat bawl a, khuam tung khat ah a koih hi. Gul in mi khatpeuh a tuk ciangin amah in tua sumngo gul enin a nungta hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl mite mainawt uh a, Oboth ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Oboth panin amaute dingkhia uh a, nisuahna lam ahi Moab gam nisuahna lam, Iye Abarim ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Tua mun panin amaute dingkhia uh a, Zered Kuam sungah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Tua mun panin amaute dingkhia uh a, Amor mite gam tawh a kizom gamlak-a om Arnon lehlampang dungah giahphual a sat uh hi. Arnon pen Moab leh Amor mite kikal-a om, Moab-te gamgi ahi hi.
Tua thu hangin Yahweh’ Galdona Laibu sungah, “Suphah gam a Waheb leh guamthuk neute, Arnon leh,
Ar mite tenna mun dong a bansukin Moab gamgi-a om, tua guamthuk neu keente” a kici hi.
Tua mun panin pai-in Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Mite kaikhawm tuah inla, amaute tui ka pia ding hi,” ci-in a genna mun tuikhuk, Be’er ah a pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl-te in hih la sa uh hi: “Tuikhuk aw, hong phulkhia in! Na vekun hih thu, la sak un,
makaite tawh tuikhuk, amau’ ciangkhutte tawh Thukham piapa sawlna hangin leh gam mithupite hangin a kito tuikhuk,” a ci uh hi. Gamlak panin Mattanah ah amaute a pai uh hi.
Mattanah panin Nahaliel ah; Nahaliel panin Bamoth ah;
Bamoth panin sehnel gam a kimuhsuk theihna Pisgah mual dawn, Moab gam sunga kuam khat ah tung uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Israyl-te in Amor mite’ kumpipa, Sihon kiangah kamtaite sawlin a gen inah:

“Kote, na gam hong kantansak in. Lo ahi a, leenggui lo ahi zong lam ka pial kei ding uh a, tuikhuk khatpeuh panin tui ka dawn kei ding uh hi. Na gam ka kantankhit matengun kumpipa’ lamlian tawnin ka pai ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Ahih hangin Sihon in Israyl-te a gam sung kantanin tawnsak lo hi. Amah in a mite khempeuh kaikhawmin, gamlak ah Israyl-te a do dingin a kuankhia uh hi. Yatzah ah amah a tun ciangin, Israyl-te tawh a kido hi.

Tua tak ciangin Israyl-te in namsau hiam tawh amah do-in zo uh a, Arnon panin Yatzah ah, Ammon mite kiang dong bek a gam-a neihsa laksak uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Ammon mite’ gamgi pen kulhpi muanhuai ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl-te in hih khuapite khempeuh la-in, tuate ah teng uh a, Heshbon leh a kiimkot-a tenna munte khempeuh zong a kihel hi.
Heshbon pen Moab kumpi masazawpa do-in, Arnon ciang dong a gam khempeuh a laksak, Amor mite kumpipa Sihon’ khuapi ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin la a sa pawlte in, “Heshbon ah hong pai-in, kilamkiksak unla, Sihon’ khuapi kipiakik tahen.
Heshbon panin meikuang paikhia-in, Sihon’ khuapi panin meikuang paikhia ahih manin, Moab mite’ khuapi Ar, Arnon mual sang gammite a kangtum hi.
Moab aw, na dahhuai hi! Chemosh mite aw, nang hong kisusia hi! Amah in a tapate galtai bangin, a tanute galmat bangin Amor mi Sihon kumpipa tungah piakhin ta hi.
Ahih hangin kote in amaute ka zozo uh a, Dibon ciang dongah Heshbon-te a simangkhin uh hi. Tua ciangin kote in Medeba a ban Nophah ciang dong ka siasak uh hi,” ci-in sa uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Amor mite gam sungah Israyl-te teng uh hi.
Mosheh in Yazer ah thukansimte a sawlkhit ciangin, Israyl mite in a kiimkot-a a teng mite manin, tua lai-a om Amor mite a hawlkhia uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute kihei-in Bashan lampaina lamlian dung ah paito uh a, Bashan kumpipa Og leh a galkap buppi pen Edrei ah amaute a do dingin kuankhia uh hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Amah lau kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh amah leh a galkap buppi leh a gam tawh nangma tungah kong piakhin hi. Heshbon ah a teng Amor mite kumpipa Sihon tungah na hih bangin ama tungah na hih ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl-te in amah, a tapate, leh a mite khempeuh, khatbeek a suakta loin dozo uh hi. Amaute in a gam luahin a tang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moab leitamzang ah Israyl mite zinkhia uh a, Yericho nai, Yardan gundung ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Tu-in Israyl-te in Amor mite a bawlna khempeuh Zippor’ tapa Balak in mu a,
amaute tam lua mahmah uh ahih manin Moab a lau mahmah hi. Israyl mite hangin Moab pen lau-in liinna tawh a kidim hi.

Tua ahih manin Moab in Midian upate kiangah, “Bawngtal in gamlak lopate a liaktum bangin hih mihonte in i kiimkot khempeuh liaktum mang ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin tua hun lai-in Moab kumpipa ahi Zippor’ tapa Balak in,

ama pianna gam sung, Euphrates Gun nai-a, Pethor ah a om Beor’ tapa Balaam a sam dingin kamtaite a sawl hi. Balak in, “Egypt gam panin mite hong piakhia uh hi. Amaute in lei maitang khempeuh tuamcip uh a, keima zom ah phualsatkhin uh hi.

Tu-in hong pai inla, hih mite tungah samsiatna pia in; bang hang hiam cihleh kei aa dingin amaute thahat lua mahmah uh hi. Tua hileh amaute zo-in hih gam panin ka hawlkhiazo kha ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh na thupha piak mite in thupha a ngahna leh na samsiat mite in samsiatna a ngahna thu ka thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Moab upate leh Midian upate kuankhia uh a, a khut sung uh ah aisanna thaman ding keng uh hi. Balaam kiangah amaute a tun uh ciangin, Balak in a gensa thute ama kiangah a gen uh hi.
Balaam in amaute kiangah, “Tuzan hih lai-ah giak phot un. Yahweh in kei tungah dawnna hong piak bang tektekin note kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Balaam tawh Moab makaite a om uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Balaam kiangah Yahweh pai a, “Nang tawh a om hih mite kuate ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Balaam in Yahweh kiangah, “Zippor’ tapa, Moab kumpipa Balak in kei kiangah hih thu hong puak hi:

‘Egypt gam panin hong paikhia mite in lei maitang teng tuamcip uh hi. Tu-in hong pai inla, kei aa dingin amaute hong samsiatsak in. Tua hileh amaute do-in a gamla ah ka hawlkhia thei kha ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Balaam kiangah, “Amaute tawh pai kei in. Tua mite na samsia peuhmah kei ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh tua mite thupha a kipia mite ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.
A zingsang ciangin Balaam thoto a, Balak’ makaite kiangah, “Na gam uh ah ciahkik un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in note tawh kong pai ding phalna hong pia lo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Balak kiangah Moab makaite ciahkik uh a, “Balaam in kote tawh hong pai ding hong nial hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Balak in a masa sangin a tamzaw leh a zahtakhuaizaw adang makaite sawl hi.
Balaam kiangah amaute tung uh a, ama kiangah, “Hih pen Zippor’ tapa Balak in a gen ahi hi: Kei kiangah nong pai nadingin bangmah kikol-awksak kei in,
bang hang hiam cihleh keimah in thaman lianpi kong pia taktak ding a, nong cih bangbang ka hih ding hi. Hong pai inla, kei aa dingin hih mite hong samsiatsak in, hong cisak hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Balaam in dawng a, Balak’ makaite kiangah, “Balak in ngun leh kham tawh a kidim a kumpi inn hong pia phial zongin, Yahweh’ kammal banah Ama genna sangin a tawmzaw ahi a, a tamzaw ahi zongin a sem dingin ka gamta thei kei hi.
Tu-in tua ahih manin, adang mite a taam mah bangin tuzan zong hih lai ah hong taam unla, Yahweh in kei tungah bang hong genbeh lai ding hiam cih ka kankhia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua zanin Balaam kiangah Yahweh pai a, ama kiangah, “Amaute in nang hong sam dingin hong tung uh ahih nungsang, tho inla, amaute tawh pai in. Ahih hangin nangma tungah kong gen thu lian bek pen nangmah in thupia-in na gen ding thu ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin zingsangin Balaam thoto a, a laa tutphah vawhin, Moab makaite tawh a pai hi.
Ahih hangin amah a paina hangin Yahweh heh mahmah a, Yahweh’ vantungmi in a khaktan dingin a pai nadingin lampi ah na pang hi. Ama laa tungah Balaam tuang a, a nasemte in amah tawh a om hi.

Yahweh’ vantungmi in a khutsung ah namsau dawksa-in lampi ah a dinna, a laa in a muh ciangin, lampi panin pialin gamlak ah a pai hi. Tua ahih manin Balaam in lampi ah a paikik nadingin a laa a sat hi.
Tua tak ciangin leenggui lo kikal, a pang tuakah phung a omna lam kawcik ah vantungmi na ding leuleu hi.
A laa in Yahweh’ vantungmi a muh ciangin phung phu-in phungah Balaam’ khe a nencip hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a laa satkik leuleu hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi a gamla ah na mapai-in, taklam ah ahi a, veilam ah ahi zongin a kipial theih lohna mun kawcik khatah na ding hi.
Tua bang din mun ah a laa in Yahweh’ vantungmi a muh ciangin, Balaam nuai-ah a laa bokcip hi. Tua tak ciangin Balaam heh mahmah a, a ciangkhut tawh a laa a sat hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in a laa kam honsak a, amah in Balaam kiangah, “Hih a thumveina dong nong sat nadingin nang tungah bang hong bawl ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Balaam in a laa dawngin, “A hangin nangmah in kei nong hai bawl hi. Ka khut sungah namsau om hileh tu mahmahin kong that ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin a laa in Balaam kiangah, “Nang aa ka hih-a kipanin tuni ciang dong na tuanna nangma laa hi lo ka hi hiam? Hih bang danin nang hong bawl ngei ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Nong bawl kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Balaam’ mitte honsak a, amah in a namsau doksa-in lampi ah a ding Yahweh’ vantungmi a mu hi. Tua ahih manin amah nakpitakin kunsukin, a maitang in lei a ban hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in amah kiangah, “Bang hangin na laa hih a thum veina dong sat na hi hiam? Na dan pen Yahweh mai-ah lamkhial khat bang ahih manin hih lai mun ah nang hong dal dingin hong pai ka hi hi.
Na laa in kei hong mu-in hih a thum veina dong kei kiang panin kihemkhia hi. Kei kiang panin amah kihemkhia lo hi leh, tu-in nang kong thatkhin taktak ding a, ahih hangin na laa ka hingsak ding hi.
Balaam in Yahweh’ vantungmi kiangah, “Ka mawhkhin hi. Kei hong dalin lampi ah na dinlam kong thei kha kei hi. Tu-in hih in nang hong lungkim losak ahih leh, ka kilehkik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in Balaam kiangah, “Mite tawh pai inla, ahih hangin nang kong gen thu bek lian gen in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Balak’ makaite tawh Balaam a pai hi.
Tu-in Balak in Balaam hong paina thu a zak ciangin, ama gam nawl, Arnon gamgi-a om Moab khuapi ah amah a dawn dingin a pai hi.
Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Kintakin thu hong zasakin, nang hong samsak hilo ka hi hiam? Bang hangin hong pai lo na hi hiam? Thaman hong pia zolo ding mi ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Hi mah hi, tu-in nang kiang kong tungkhin a, ahih hangin thu khat peuhpeuh ka gen thei kei hi. Yahweh in ka kam sunga a koih thu bek ka gen pelmawh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Kiryath Huzoth lam manawhin Balak tawh Balaam a pai hi.
Balak in bawngtalte leh tuute tawh biakna pia-in, Balaam leh amah tawh a om makaite tungah pawlkhat a pia hi.
A zingciangin a mi gente a tamna mu dingin Balak in Bamoth-Baal ah Balaam paipihto hi.
Tua ciangin Balaam in, “Kei aa dingin hih mun ah biaknatau sagih hong lamsak inla, kei aa dingin bawngtal sagih leh tuutal sagih biakna hong piaksak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Balaam in thu a piak bang lianin Balak in hih a, Balak leh Balaam in biaknatau khat ciat ah bawngtal leh tuutal tawh biakna a pia uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Keimah ka paikhiat kalin hih lai mun na biakpiakna gei-ah na om in. Kei tawh kimu dingin Yahweh hong paikha thei ding a, Amah in kei tunga hong gen peuhmah, nang kong gen ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Balaam kimuhpih a, amah in Yahweh kiangah, “Biaknatau sagih ka bawlkhin a, biaknatau khat ciat tungah bawngtal khat leh tuutal khat tawh biakna ka pia khin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Balaam’ kam sungah thukhak khat koih a, “Balak kiangah paikik inla, hih thukhak amah pia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Balak kiangah amah paikik a, meihal biakna gei-ah Moab’ makaite khempeuh tawh a ding a mu hi.

Tua ciangin Balaam in a kipia thute genkhia hi: Nisuahna lam mualte pan ahi Aram panin Balak in kei hong paipih hi. Kei aa dingin Yaaqob samsia dingin hong pai inla, Israyl mawhsak dingin hong pai in, hong ci hi.
Yahweh in a samsiat loh mite bang ci bangin keimah in samsia thei ding ka hi hiam? Yahweh in a mawhsak loh mite bang ci bangin keimah in mawhsak thei ding ka hi hiam?
Suangpite dawn panin amah ka mu a, mun sangnate panin amah ka en hi. Tua lai munah, tangtenin, amau mahmah minam dangte tawh a kibangin a kingaihsun lo mihon khat ka mu hi.

Yaaqob’ leivuite, kua in sim zo ding a, Israyl-te a malmalin kua in simzo ding ahi hiam? Thuman mite sihna ah kei hong sisak inla, amaute hun tawpna bangin ka hun tawpna hong hisak in.* (Stock of Israyl)

Tua khit ciangin Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Kei tungah hong bangci gamtat na hi hiam? Hih lai mun ah ka galte a samsia dingin nang kong paipih a, phaltakin amaute thupha na piakna ka mu zawsop hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in, “Yahweh in ka gen dingin ka kamsungah hong koih thu, awlmawh loin om peuhmah ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua tak ciangin Balak in ama kiangah, “Amaute na muh theih nading a mun dang khat ah kei tawh hong pai in; amaute a nawl lama omte bek na mu ding a, ahih hangin a vekpi-in na mu kei ding hi. Tua lai mun panin amaute hong samsiatsak in.
Tua ahih manin amah in Zophim gamlak, Pisgah mual dawn ah amah paipihin, biaknatau sagih bawl a, biaknatau khat ciat ah bawngtal khat leh tuutal khat tawh biakna a pia hi.
Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Hua lamah ka kimuh sungin na meihal biaknatau gei hih lai mun ah na om in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Balaam kimuhpih a, a kam sungah thukhak khat koihin, “Balak kiangah paikik inla, hih thu ama tungah na gen ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah paikik a, a meihal biakna gei ah a ding mu-in, Moab makaite amah tawh a om hi. Balak in ama kiangah, “Yahweh in bang hong gen ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Balaam in a kipia thute genkhia hi: “Balak aw, tho inla, ngai in. Zippor’ tapa aw, ka thugen za in.

A zuau thei dingin Yahweh pen mihing hi lo a, a kisik thei dingin mihing tapa hi lo hi. Ama gen bang hi a, a gen bangin sem lo ding ahi hiam? A genkhitsa thu bang hi a, Amah in tangtungsak lo ding ahi hiam?
En in, thupha piak ding thu ka ngah hi. Amah in thupha piakhit ciangin keimah in ka khelkik thei kei hi.
Kuamah in Yaaqob sungah mawhna mu ngei lo hi. Israyl sungah gamtatsiatna zong kimu ngei tuan lo hi. Yahweh ama Pa in amah om pih a, Kumpipa kikona amaute lakah om hi.
Yahweh in Egypt gam panin amaute paikhiat pih a, Amah in gamsial bangin a thahatsak hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yaaqob tawh kibum nading om lo a, Israyl tawh aisanna khatbeek zong a om tuan kei hi. Tu-in Yaaqob leh Israyl tawh kisai-in, ‘Yahweh’ sepna en un!’ kici ding hi.
Humpinelkaipi bangin thoto-in humpinelkai apa bangin amau mah a dingto mite, en un. A mat sate kituhin a nekkhit mateng, kithahna sisan a dawn khit matengin lumsuk lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Amaute samsiatna zong pia nawn kei inla, thupha zong pia nawn kei in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Balaam in dawng a, Balak kiangah, “Yahweh in hong gen khempeuh, ka hih loh phamawh hi, hong cimah hi lo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Hong pai in, mun dang ah hong paipih ning. Tua lai mun panin kei aa dingin amaute nong samsiatsak nading Yahweh in nang hong phal kha thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Balak in sehnel gam a kimuh sukna Peor mual dawn ah Balaam paipih hi.
Tua ciangin Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Hih lai-ah kei aa dingin biaknatau sagih hong lamsak inla, kei aa dingin bawngtal sagih leh tuutal sagih tawh biakna hong piaksak in,” a ci hi.
Balaam in a gen bangin Balak in hih a, biaknatau khat ciat ah bawngtal khat leh tuutal khatta biakna-in a pia hi.
Tu-in Israyl-te thupha piak ding, Yahweh’ lungkimna ahih lam Balaam in a theih ciangin, amah in a hun dangte-a bangin ki-hilna lim a mu dingin pai lo a, a maitang gamlak lam ngat hi.
Balaam a khuadak ciangin, amau minam tawh kizui-in giahphual a sat Israyl-te mu a, Yahweh’ Kha ama tungah hong tung hi.
Amah in a kipia thute genkhia hi; Beor’ tapa Balaam’ thugen, a mit a kihong mipa thugen,
Yahweh’ kammalte a za, Vanglian Penpa kiang panin mangmuhna a mu, lung-am-in tuk napi-in a mitte a kihong mipa thugen in:
Yaaqob aw, na puanbukte uh bang zahtakin hoih ahi hiam! Israyl aw, na tenna munte uh bangzah takin hoih ahi hiam!
A saupi a kiphah kuamte tawh kibang a, gun gei-a om huante tawh ki bang hi. Yahweh in a suan aloes paknamtui kungte tawh kibang a, tui kianga om taamtak kungte tawh kibang hi.
A phelkhaite panin tui luang ding a, a khaicite in tui tampi ngah ding uh hi. A Kumpipa uh Agag sangin lianzaw ding a, Ama Kumpi Gam kitawisang ding hi.

Yahweh in Egypt panin amah paikhiatpih hi; Amaute in gamsial bangin amaute thahat uh hi. Amaute in amau’ gal uh ahi minamte netum ding uh hi. Amaute in a galte uh guhte suzan ding uh a, a thaltangte uh tawh amaute kaplet ding uh hi.

Amaute bok a, humpinelkai pa bangin lumsuk uh hi. Humpinelkai a bang mi kua in phong ngam ding ahi hiam? Nang thupha hong pia mi thupha ngah hi a, nang hong samsiat mi samsiatna a ngah ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Balaam’ tungah Balak’ hehna hong kuang a, amah in a khut leh a khut a tuum hi. Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Ka galte a samsia dingin nang kong sam hi, ahih hangin nangmah in hih a thum veina dong amaute thupha na pia hi.
Tu mahmahin paikhia in! Keimah in thaman lianpi kong pia ding hi kong ci hi, ahih hangin na thaman ngah nading panin Yahweh in nang hong khaktan hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Kei kianga kamtai nongsawlte kiangah:

Balak in ngun leh kham tawh a kidim a kumpi inn hong pia phial zongin, Yahweh’ thupiakna banah keima utthu-in a sia ahi a, a pha ahi zongin ka hih thei kei a, Yahweh in gen dingin hong thupiak bek ka gen hamtang kul hi, hong ci hilo ka hi hiam?
Tu-in ka mipihte kiangah a pai ding ka hita hi. Hong pai in, nidang ciangin hih mite in na mite tungah a bawl dingte kong theisak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in a thugen dingte gen a, Beor’ tapa Balaam’ thugen, a mittangte a kihonsak mipa thugen,
Yahweh’ kammalte za-in, Sang Penpa’ thutheihna a thei, Vanglian Penpa kiang panin mangmuhna a mu, lung-am-in tuk napi-in a mittangte a kihong mipa’ thugen in:

Amah ka mu hi, ahih hangin tun hi lo hi; Amah ka en a, ahih hangin hong nai nailo hi. Yaaqob sung panin Aksi khat hong suakkhia ding a, Israyl panin Kumpi Ciangkhut hong dingkhia ding hi; Moab thaltang satkham ding a, Seth’ tapate ahi a gamlum henhan a galte khempeuh sugawp ding hi.
Edom kisuan khia ding hi. Hangsantakin Israyl in a hih sungin a galte ahi Seir zong kisuankhia ding hi.
Yaaqob sung panin Ukpa Khat hong suakkhia ding a, khuapi sunga a suaktate susia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in Amalek mite enin, ama thugen ding teng gen a, “minamte lakah Amalek a masa pen hi a, ama hun tawpna pen suksiat maimangna ahi hi” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in Ken mite enin, ama thugen ding teng gen a, “Na omna mun a kho hangin, suangpi tungah na bu a kilam hangin,
Kain kibeisak ding hi. Asshur in galmatin bang tanvei hong nei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in a gen ding teng gen a, “Ala! Yahweh in hihte a hih ciangin kua nungtazo ding ahi hiam?

Ahih hangin Greece’ tuipi dung panin teembawte hong pai ding a, Asshur gimsak ding hi; Euphrates pan langkhat-a a teng, Eber gimsak ding hi. Ahih hangin amah in zong suksiatna thuak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Balaam dingto-in, a inn ah a ciahkik dingin paikhia a, Balak zong a pai nading ah pai hi.
Shittim ah Israyl mite a om laitakin, Moab mi numeite tawh tatsiatakin paktat ding kipan uh hi.
Hih numeite in amau’ pasian biaknate ah Israyl mite sam uh a, Israyl mite pai uh a, amau’ pasiante mai-ah a kun uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl-te in Peor Baal biakna sungah kihel uh a, amaute tungah Yahweh heh mahmah hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Mipi makaite khempeuh sam inla, ngeina tawh kilehbulh-a a gamta mite that in. Israyl-te kiang panin Yahweh’ heh mahmahna a bei nadingin Yahweh mai, sun nitang nuai-ah amaute khai in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in Israyl’ thukhente kiangah, “Baal Peor-a biakna tawh a va kizom na mite uh a kuamapeuh na that ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl mi khat hong pai-in, Mosheh muhna leh Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah kapin a om Israyl mihon khempeuh muhna ah Midian mi numei khat ama innkuanpihte kiangah hong ciahpih hi.
Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar, Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas in a muh ciangin, mihonte nusia-in paikhia a, a khut sungah teipi khat a la hi.

Amah in Israyl mipa nungzuih a, a puanbuk sung, a lupna khan sung dong ah a pai hi. Amah in Israyl mipa leh a numei, a numei’ pumpi pailetin a nihin sun khawm hi. Tua tak ciangin Israyl mite lakah pulnatna veng pah a,
Ahih hangin pulnatna tawh a si mi phazah pen 24,000 a pha hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:

“Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar, Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas in Israyl mite kiang panin Ka hehna vengsak hi. Amaute lakah Ka Zahtakhuaina a bei loh nadingin ka hihteeltal mah bangin amah zong hiteeltal ahih manin Israyl mite lakah Ka hihteeltalna tawh amaute ka beisak kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ama kiangah gen in, amah tawh Keima kilemna thuciam a bawl ding ka hi hi.

Amah leh a suanlekhakte in tawntung siampi hihna thuciam nei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen Yahweh’ zahtakhuaina aa dingin hiteeltal a, Israyl mite aa dingin mawhkhuhna a bawlsakna hang ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Midian numei tawh a kithat Israyl mipa min pen Zimri hi a, Simeon innkuan makai Salu, Salu’ tapa ahi hi.
A kithat Midian numei’ min pen Cozbi hi a, Midian innkuan sungah a beh lutang Zur, Zur’ tanu ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Midian mite gal bangin bawl inla, amaute that in;

bang hang hiam cihleh Peor-a thupiang tawh kisai-in leh Peor hangin a piang pulnatna hun sungin a kithat Cozbi’ thu tawh kisai-in amaute in nang hong khem uh a, amaute in gal bangin nang hong bawl uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua pulnatna khit ciangin, Yahweh in Mosheh tung leh siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar tungah a gen inah:
“Israyl mihonte khempeuh kum sawmnih pan a tungsiah, a pu a pate innkuante tawh kizui-in, Israyl sung panin gal do dingin a kuankhia thei ding khempeuh mi simna nei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yericho nai, Yardan kiang, Moab leitamzang ah Mosheh leh siampi Eleazar in amaute kiangah a gen inah:
“Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bang tektekin Egypt gam panin a paikhia Israyl mite, kum 20 pan a tungsiah a pha pasal-te mi simna nei un,” a ci hi. Hihte pen hih mi kisimna sunga a kihel mite ahi uh hi:
Amau’ behte tawh kizui-in Israyl’ tacil Reuben’ suanlekhakte in: Hanoch pan Hanoch beh mite piang uh hi; Pallu pan Pallu beh mite piang uh hi;
Hezron pan Hezron beh mite piang uh hi; Carmi pan Carmi beh mite piang uh hi.
Hihte pen Reuben’ tapate panin piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 43,730 a pha hi.
Pallu’ tapa pen Eliab hi a,

Eliab’ tapate pen Nemuel, Dathan, leh Abiram ahi hi. Hih Dathan leh Abiram pen mihonte in Yahweh’ langpangin a seel uh ciangin Mosheh leh Aaron a langpan mite’ tangin a pang Korah tawh a kipawlte ahi uh hi.
Mei in mihing 250 a kattum lai-in, lei in a kam ka-in Korah tawh amaute lei in nawnvalhin, a nungzuite zong a si hi; amaute pen thuhilhna lim khat a suak hi.
Ahi zongin Dathan leh Abiram-te gui a sih loh mah bangin Korah’ gui pen si lo hi.
A behbehin Simeon’ suanlekhakte in: Nemuel pan Nemuel beh mite piang hi; Yamin pan Yamin beh mite piang hi; Yakin pan Yakin beh mite piang hi;
Zerah pan Zerah beh mite piang a, Shaul sung panin Shaul beh mite piang hi.
Hihte pen Simeon’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 22,200 a pha hi.
A behbehin Gad’ suanlekhakte in: Zephon panin Zephon beh mite piang hi; Haggi panin Haggi beh mite piang hi; Shuni panin Shuni beh mite piang hi;
Ozni panin Ozni beh mite piang hi; Eri panin Eri beh mite piang hi;
Arodi panin Arodi beh mite piang hi; Areli panin Areli beh mite piang hi.
Hihte pen Gad’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 40,500 a pha hi.
Er leh Onan pen Yahdah’ tapate hi a, ahih hangin Canaan gam sungah a si uh hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in Yahdah’ suanlekhakte in: Shelah panin Shelah beh mite piang hi; Perez panin Perez beh mite piang hi; Zerah panin Zerah beh mite piang hi.
Ama behte tawh kizui-in Perez’ suanlekhakte in: Hezron panin Hezron beh mite piang hi; Hamul panin Hamul beh mite piang hi.
Hihte pen Yahdah’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 76,500 a pha hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in Issachar’ suanlekhakte in: Tola panin Tola beh mite piang hi; Puah panin Puah beh mite piang hi;
Yashub panin Yashub beh mite piang uh hi; Shimron panin Shimron beh mite piang uh hi.
Hihte pen Issachar’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 64,300 a pha hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in Zebulun’ suanlekhakte in: Sered panin Sered beh mite piang hi; Elon panin Elon beh mite piang hi; Yachleel panin Yachleel beh mite piang uh hi.
Hihte pen Zebulun’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 60,500 a pha hi.
Menasheh leh Ephraim behte tungtawnin Yahseph’ suanlekhakte in:
Ama behte tawh kizui-in Menasheh’ suanlekhakte in: Machir panin Machir mite beh ahi hi. Machir pen Gilead’ pa ahi hi. Gilead pen Gilead beh mite pianna pupi ahi hi.
Hihte pen amau behte tawh kizui-in Gilead’ suanlekhakte ahi hi: Iezer panin Iezer beh mite piang hi; Helek panin Helek beh mite piang hi;
Asriel panin Asriel beh mite piang hi; Shechem panin Shechem beh mite piang hi;
Shemida panin Shemida beh mite piang hi; Hepher panin Hepher beh mite piang hi.
Hepher’ tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei loin, tanu bek nei a, a tanute min pen Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah leh Tirzah ahi hi.
Hihte pen Yahseph’ tapa Menasheh, Menasheh’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 52,700 a pha hi.
Ama behte tawh kizui-in Ephraim’ suanlekhakte in: Shuthelah panin Shuthelah beh mite piang hi; Beker panin Beker beh mite piang hi; Tahan panin Tahan beh mite piang hi.
Eran’ tungtawnin Shuthelah’ suanlekhakte in Eran beh mite piang hi.
Hihte pen Yahseph’ tapa Ephraim, Ephraim’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 32,500 a pha hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in Benyamin’ suanlekhakte in: Bela panin Bela beh mite piang hi; Ashbel panin Ashbel beh mite piang hi; Ahiram panin Ahiram beh mite piang hi.
Shupham panin Shupham beh mite piang hi; Hupham panin Hupham beh mite piang hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in, Ard leh Naaman tungtawnin Bela’ suanlekhakte in: Ard panin Ard beh mite piang hi; Naaman panin Naaman beh mite piang hi.
Hihte pen Benyamin’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 45,600 a pha hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in Dan’ suanlekhakte in: Shuham panin Shuham beh mite piang hi. Hihte pen Dan’ behte ahi hi:
Amaute a vek khempeuhin Shuham mite’ behte ahi uh hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 64,400 a pha hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in Asher’ suanlekhakte in: Yimna panin Yimna beh mite piang uh hi; Yishwi panin Yishwi beh mite piang uh hi; Beriah panin Beriah beh mite piang uh hi.
Beriah’ suanlekhakte’ tungtawnin: Heber pan Heber beh mite piang hi; Malkiel pan Malkiel beh mite piang hi.
Asher in tanu khat nei a, a min Serah ahi hi.
Hihte pen Asher’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 53,400 a pha hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in Naphtali’ suanlekhakte in: Yachzeel pan Yachzeel beh mite piang hi; Guni pan Guni beh mite piang hi;
Yezer pan Yezer beh mite piang hi; Shillem pan Shillem beh mite piang hi.
Hihte pen Naphtali’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute a kisim mi pen 45,400 a pha hi.
Israyl mi pasal a vekpi-in 601,730 a pha hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Amau’ minte tawh kizui-in hih mite tungah luah dingin leitang kihawm ding hi.
Minam a tamte tungah gamh a tam na pia ding a, minam a tawm mite tungah gamh a tawm na pia ding hi. Minam khempeuh in a mi phazah tawh kizui-in gamh ngah ding uh hi.
Leitang pen aisanna tawh kihawm ding hi. Beh phungpi khat ciat in hih bang danin gamh ngah ding uh hi.
Gamh peuhmah pen aisanna tawh a tawm leh a tawm kihawm ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amau behte tawh kizui-in Levi’ suanlekhakte in: Gershon panin Gershon beh mite piang hi; Kohath panin Kohath beh mite piang hi; Merari panin Merari beh mite piang hi.
Hihte zong Levi behte ahi hi: Libni beh, Hebron beh, Mahli beh, Mushi beh, leh Korath beh ahi hi. Kohath pen Amram’ pa ahi hi.
Amram’ zi min pen Yahchebed hi a, Egypt gam sungah a suak Levi’ tanu ahi hi. Tua nu in Amram tawh Aaron, Mosheh leh a sanggam uh Miriam nei hi.
Aaron in Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar a nei hi.
Ahih hangin Nadab leh Abihu-te in Yahweh mai-ah zahtak loin leh phalna ngah lo pi-in mei tawh biakna a piak uh ciangin amau tenih a si uh hi. (Mi kisimna 3:4)

Hihte pen Levi’ tapate pana piang behte ahi hi. Amaute, kha khat panin a tungsiah a pha, a kisim mi pen 23,000 a pha uh hi. Amaute pen Israyl’ minam dangte tawh kisim khawm lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Israyl-te lakah gamh ngah lo uh hi.
Hihte pen Yericho nai, Yardan kiang, Moab leitamzang ah Israyl’ suante a sim Mosheh leh siampi Eleazar tungtawnin a kisim mite ahi hi.
Sinai Sehnel gam sungah amaute in Israyl’ suante a sim lai-un, Mosheh leh Aaron in a sim uh mite lakah amaute khat zong kihel lo uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amaute kiangah, “Gamlak ah amaute a si taktak ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Nun’ tapa Yahshua leh Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb lobuang amaute khat beek om nawn lo uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahseph’ ta Menasheh beh panin Menasheh’ tapa Machir, Machir’ tapa Gilead, Gilead’ tapa Hepher, Hepher’ tapa Zelophehad’ tanute hong pai uh hi. Zelophehad’ tanute’ min pen Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah leh Tirzah ahi hi.
Mosheh, siampi Eleazar leh Israyl mihon makaite khempeuh mai-ah a ding dingin kikhopna biakbuk paina lam ah amaute hong neh uh hi. Amaute in amaute kiangah:
“Gamlak ah ka pa uh sikhin a, ahih hangin amah pen Yahweh’ langpangin a kikaikhawm Korah nungzuite lakah kihel lo hi; ahih hangin ama mawhna hangin amah si a, tapa nei lo hi.
Amah in tapa a neih loh manin bang hangin ama beh sung panin ka pa uh min mangthang ding ahi hiam? Tua ahih manin ka pa’ sanggamte lak ah kote gamh hong pia un,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mosheh in Yahweh mai-ah amaute’ thu paipih hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Zelophehad’ tanute in a man thu a gen uh ahi hi. Amau’ pa’ sanggamte lakah neihsa gamh amaute tungah na pia ding a, amau’ pa’ gamh amaute’ tungah na tungsak ding hi.
Nangmah in Israyl mite tungah na gen ding a, ‘Pasal khat si-in tapa a neih kei leh, ama gamh a tanu na luahsak ding uh hi.
Amah in tanu a neih kei leh, ama gamh a sanggam pasalte na luahsak ding uh hi.
Amah in sanggam pasal a neih kei leh, ama gamh a pa’ sanggam pasalte na luah sak ding uh hi.

A pa in sanggam pasal a neih kei leh, a beh sunga ama kinaipih pen tungah ama gamh pia ding a, amah in tang ding hi. Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bang tektekin, hih pen Israyl mite tungah thukhenna ngeina khat hi ding hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Abarim huam hih mual tung, Nebo vuumte panin khat ahi Pisgah mual dawn ah paito inla, Israyl mite tungah ka piakkhitsa gam en in.
Nangmah in tua gam na muhkhit ciangin, na sanggampa Aaron a mipihte kiangah a kigawm bang lianin nang zong na mipihte kiangah na kigawm ding hi.

Ahang in Zin Sehnel gam sunga tuite ah mihonte a phun lai un, amaute’ muhna ah A Siangtho-in Kei nong Pahtawi nadingin Kong thupiakna na nihtuakun nong mang kei uh hi,” a ci hi. (Hihte pen Zin Sehnel gam sunga om Kadesh-a, Meribah tuite ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah:
“Mihingte’ khate a kikhel kawikawina thei-in a Telcian Yahweh aw, mihonte a uk ding,
Yahweh’ mihonte, a cing ding nei lo tuuhon a bat lohna dingin, amaute mai-ah paikhia-in, amaute mai-ah a tum ding, amaute makaihkhia-in, amaute a paipih ding mi khat seh in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Ama lungsim ka telcian mi, Nun’ tapa Yahshua pen nang tawh sam inla, ama tungah na khut nga in;
Siampi Lian Eleazar mai, mihon khempeuh mai-ah dingsak inla, amaute muhna ah amah za pia in.
Israyl mihon buppi in ama thu a man nadingin nangma thuneihna pawlkhat amah pia in.

Yahweh mai-ah Urim thudotna tawh ama aa dingin Keima khensatnate a sang ding, Siampi Lian Eleazar mai-ah amah ding ding hi. Tua khit ciangin ama thupiakna tawh amah leh Israyl mihon buppi khempeuh pusuak ding uh a, ama thupiakna mah tawh sungtum ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in amah a thupiak bangin Mosheh gamta hi: Amah in Yahshua la-in Siampi Lian Eleazar mai leh mihon khempeuh mai-ah dingsak hi;
Amah in a lutungah a khut nga a, Yahweh in Mosheh tungtawnin a thupiakna bang tektekin amah in Yahshua tungah za a pia hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite thupia inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Keima tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in mei tawh kihal Ka biaknate aa dingin an, a kiseh hun-in Keima tungah nong piak ding uh phawk un,’ ci-in gen in.
Nangmah in amaute kiangah, ‘Hih pen Yahweh tungah na piak ding uh mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi: a sitbaang lo, kum khat a pha tuuno nih, ngeina bangin meihal biakna-in ni simin na pia ding uh hi;
Zingsangin tuuno khat biakpiakna-in na pia ding a, nitak nih kikalin a tuuno khat pen na pia ding uh hi.
A kigawi olive sathau hin khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat tawh a kipawi annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat, an tawh biakna-in tuuno khat ciat tawh na piakhawm ding uh hi.
Tua pen Yahweh tungah mei tawh a kihal a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in Sinai Mual ah a kikipsak, tatsat lo meihal biakna ahi hi.
Tuuno khat ciat tawh a kipia khawm ding dawna biakna hin khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat hi ding hi. Yahweh tungah dawna biakna pen Munsiangtho ah na sungkhia ding hi.

A nihna tuuno pen a ngeina omsa an tawh biakna leh a ngeina omsa dawna biakna tawh nitak nih kikalin biakpiakna-in pia in. Nangmah in tua pen Yahweh tungah mei tawh kihal biakna, a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in na pia ding hi.

Shabbat ni-in a sitbaang lo kum khat a pha tuuno nih biakna pen dawna biakna leh tuuno khat ciat aa dingin sathau tawh a kipawi annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-nih tawh na bawl khawm ding hi.
Tua pen tatsat lo-a meihal biakna; zingsang leh nitak Tamid, leh dawna biakna banah Shabbat simin meihal biakna ahi hi.
Khadet sim, a ni masa ni-in Yahweh tungah meihal biakna-in bawngtalno nih leh tuutal khat, a sitbaang lo kum khat a pha a vekin tuuno sagih na pia ding uh hi.

Bawngtal khat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-thum sathau tawh a kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi; tuutal khat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-nih sathau tawh a kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi;

tuuno khat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat sathau tawh a kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi. Tua pen meihal biakna aa dingin a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in Yahweh tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi.

Bawngtal khat ciangin dawna biakna leenggahzu hin lang hi ding hi; tuutal khat ciangin dawna biakna leenggahzu hin khat seh-thum-suah-seh-khat hi ding hi; tuuno khat ciangin dawna biakna hin khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat hi ding hi. Tua pen kum khat sunga om khadet simin a kibawl meihal biakna ahi hi.
Tua banah Khadet ni masa ni-in a kibawl dawna biakna tawh tatsat lo-a meihal biakna; zingsang leh nitak Tamid, keeltal khat zong mawhna hanga biakna-in Yahweh tungah piak ding ahi hi.
Kha khat kha a ni Sawm le Li ni, nitak nih kikalin Yahweh’ Paisan tuuno kigo ding hi;
Tua Kha a ni Sawm le Nga ni pen Pawi hi a, ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum pel loin kine ding hi.
Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a ni Masa Ni pen a siangtho kikhopna khat ahi hi. Na nasep ngeite uh na sem kei ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin note in meihal biakna bawngtal nih leh tuutal khat, kum khat a pha a vekin tuuno sagih, Yahweh tungah mei tawh a kihal biakna-in na pia ding uh hi. Tuate a sitbaang lo ahih ding theitel un.

Bawngtal khat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-thum sathau tawh a kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi; tuutal khat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-nih sathau tawh a kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi;
tuuno sagihte khat ciat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat sathau tawh kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi.
Note aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlna dingin mawhna hanga biakna keeltal khat zong kihel ding hi.
Tatsat lo-a zingsang meihal biakna banah hihte bawlin biakna na pia ding hi.

Hih bang danin Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in ni sagih sung, ni simin mei tawh kihal biakna dingin an kiging un. Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi sung tawntung tatsat lo-a meihal biakna; zingsang leh nitak Tamid, banah a ngeina omsa bangin dawna biakna tawh tuate kipia ding hi.
Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a ni sagih ni-in, note in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi. Note in na sep ngeite uh sem loin na ut peuhpeuh na sem kei ding uh hi.

Nipi kal Pawi ah an thak tawh biakna Yahweh tungah na paipih uh, anpal piak ni-in, note in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi. Note in na sep ngeite uh sem loin na ut peuhpeuh na sem kei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin note in a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin Yahweh tungah meihal biakna bawngtalno nih leh tuutal khat, kumkhat a pha a vekin tuutal sagih na pia ding uh hi.

tuuno sagihte khat ciat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat sathau tawh kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi.
Note aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlna dingin mawhna hanga biakna keeltal khat zong kihel ding hi.
Tatsat lo-a meihal biaknate leh an tawh biaknate, Zingsang leh nitak Tamid banah a ngeina omsa dawna biaknate tawh tuate bawlin biakna na pia ding uh hi. Tuate a sitbaang lo ahih ding theitel un.

A Kha Sagihna, a ni masa ni-in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi; Note in na sep ngeite uh sem loin na ut peuhpeuh na sem kei ding uh hi. Hih ni pen note in peengkulte na tum ni ding uh; Peengkul Pawi, ahi hi.
Note in Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in a vekpi-in a sitbaang lo bawngtalno khat, tuutal khat, kum khat a pha a vekin tuuno sagih tawh meihal biakna na pia ding uh hi.

tuuno sagihte khat ciat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat sathau tawh kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi.
Note aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlna dingin mawhna hanga biakna keeltal khat zong kihel ding hi.

Tatsat lo-a Khadet biakna, Zingsang leh Nitak Tamid meihal biaknate banah a ngeina omsa an leh dawn tawh biaknate tawh hih Peengkul Pawi biakna na bawl ding uh hi. Tuate pen Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in mei tawh a kihal biaknate ahi hi.
A Kha Sagihna sung a Ni Sawm ni-in, note in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi; Note in na kha uh na gawt ding uh a, nasep khatpeuh na sem nawn kei ding uh hi.

tuuno sagihte khat ciat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat sathau tawh kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi.

Mawhkhuhna aa dingin Mawhna hanga Biakna leh tatsat lo-a meihal biakna banah a ngeina omsa an leh dawn-a biakna; Zingsang leh Nitak Tamid, tawh note aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlna dingin mawhna hanga biakna keeltal khat zong kihel ding hi.

Kha Sagihna a Ni Sawm le Nga ni-in note in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi; na nasep ngeite uh sem loin na ut peuhpeuh uh na sem kei ding uh a, note in Yahweh’ Pawi; Buk Pawi, ni sagih sung na bawl ding uh hi.

Buk Pawi a Siangtho a Ni Masa ni-in note in a vekpi-in a sitbaang lo bawngtalno sawm le thum, tuutal nih, kum khat a pha tuuno apa sawm le li, meihal biakna, Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in mei tawh kihal biakna na pia ding uh hi.

Bawngtal sawm le thum pan khat ciat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-thum sathau tawh a kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi. Tuutal nih pan khat ciat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-nih sathau tawh a kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi.
Tuuno sawm le li pan khat ciat ciangin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat sathau tawh kipawi an-a biakna tawh hi ding hi.
Tatsat lo-a meihal biakna; Zingsang leh Nitak Tamid, banah a ngeina omsa bangin an leh dawna biakna tawh note aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlna dingin mawhna hanga biakna keeltal khat zong kihel ding hi.
Buk Pawi a ni nih ni-in a vekpi-in a sitbaang lo bawngtalno sawm le nih, tuutal nih leh kum khat a pha tuuno apa sawm le li biakpiakna-in na pia ding uh hi.
Bawngtalte, tuutalte, tuunote a phazah leh a ngeina omsate tawh kizui-in amaute an tawh biaknate leh dawna biaknate tawh na bawl ding hi.

Buk Pawi a ni guk ni-in a vekpi-in a sitbaang lo bawngtal giat, tuutal nih, kum khat a pha tuuno apa sawm le li biakpiakna-in na pia ding uh hi.

Buk Pawi a ni sagih ni-in a vekpi-in a sitbaang lo bawngtal sagih, tuutal nih, kum khat a pha tuuno apa sawm le li biakpiakna-in na pia ding uh hi.

A ni giat ni, A Nunung Ni Lian Ni-in, note in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi. Note in nasep ngeite sem loin na ut peuhpeuh na sem kei ding uh hi.

Na thuciam biakna ding uh, na uttawmna hanga biakna ding uh gawm behin na meihal biaknate, an tawh biaknate, dawna biaknate leh kilemna biaknate, a kiseh na Pawite ah Yahweh’ aa dingin na pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in amah a thupiaksa bang tektekin Mosheh in Israyl mi khempeuh kiangah hih thute gen hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in Israyl beh lutangte kiangah a gen inah: “Hih pen Yahweh’ thupiaknate ahi hi:

‘Mi khat in Yahweh tungah thuciamna a kiciam ciang ahi a, amah in a zuih dingin kiciamna a bawl ciang ahi zongin, amah ciampel lo ding hi. Amah in ka hih ding hi, ci-in a gen khempeuh hih pelmawh ding hi.
Numei no khat a pa’ inn sungah a om lai-in Yahweh tungah thuciamna a kiciam ciang ahi a, amah in a zuih dingin kiciamna a bawl ciang ahi zongin,
a pa in ama thuciamna ahi keileh a kiciamna za napi-in a tanu kiangah bangmah a gen kei leh, amah a khih a thuciamna khempeuh leh kiciamna peuhmah kip ding hi.

Ahih hangin a pa in a kiciamna a zak ciangin amah in tua nu a kham leh, tua nu a khih a thuciamna ahih keileh a kiciamna khat zong kip lo ding hi. A pa in amah a kham na hangin Yahweh in tua nu khah ding hi.
Tua numei in kiciamna khat a bawl khit ahih keileh amah a kikhih tawmna thuciam ngaihsun lopi-in paukhia-in a kamciam khit ciangin amah in pasal a neih leh,
A pasal in tua thute za napi-in ama kiangah bangmah a cih keileh, ama thuciamna ahih keileh, ama kikhih tawm kiciamna kip ding hi.

Ahih hangin a pasal in tua thu a zak ciangin amah in tua nu a kham leh, tua nu a khih thuciamna ahih keileh amah a khih ngaih sun lopi-in kamciamna amah in phiatsak ding a, Yahweh in tua nu khah ding hi.
Ahih hangin meigong ahi a, a kima numei in a bawl thuciamna ahikei leh kiciamna in amah mah khih ding hi.
Numei khat in a pasal tawh a om sungin thuciamna khat ahi a, kiciamna khat tawh kamciamin amah a kikhih tawmin,
a pasal in tua thu za napi-in bangmah ci loin, amah a kham kei leh, ama thuciamna khempeuh leh amah a kikhih tawm kiciamna khempeuh kip ding hi.

Ahih hangin a pasal in tua thute a zak ciangin, a phiatsak leh, a thuciamna ahih keileh a kam panin a pusuak ama kiciamna khat zong kip lo ding hi. A pasal in tuate khamkhin ahih manin Yahweh in amah khah ding hi.
A pasal in tua nu thuciamna kipsak thei a, a pasal in tua pen a mawknapi zong suaksak thei hi.

Ahih hangin ni khat khit ni khat a pasal in tua thu ama kiang bangmah a gen kei leh, tua nu a khih a thuciamna khempeuh ahi a, a kiciamna khempeuh ahi zongin a kipsak ahi hi. Amah in tua thute a zaka kipan tua nu tungah bangmah gen lohna tawh amah in a kipsakkhin ahi hi.
Ahih hangin amah in tua thute a zak khit hun sawt sim khit ciangin amah in tuate a phiat leh, amah in a zi mawhna hangin tavuan la ding hi,” a ci hi.
Hihte pen pasal leh a zi kikal, leh a pa leh a inn sunga a teng lai, a tanu no kikala kizopna tawh kisai-in Yahweh in Mosheh tungah a piak ngeinate ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite’ phu Midian mite tungah la in. Tua khit ciangin na mipihte kiangah nangmah na kigawm ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in mite kiangah, “Gal do dingin na mite uh pawlkhat galhiam guan unla, Midian’ tungah Yahweh aa dingin phu a la dingin Midian mite do dingin paisak un.
Israyl minam khat panin pasal tul khat ciat gal sungah a kuan ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl beh tuamtuamte panin minam khat ciangin pasal tul khat ta, pasal tul sawm le tul nih galdo dingin galhiam kiguan uh hi.
Tua ciangin a siangtho nazatte leh thu kizaksakna peengkulte a khut sungah a tawi siampi Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas tawh, Mosheh in amaute, minam khat panin tul khat ta galdo dingin a sawl hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh thupiak bang tektekin amaute in Midian mite do uh a, amaute in pasal khempeuh that uh hi.
Amaute in Midian’ kumpite that uh hi; Midian kumpi ngate’ min pen Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, leh Reba ahi hi. Amaute in namsau tawh Beor’ tapa Balaam zong that uh hi.
Israyl mite in Midian nupite leh a tate khempeuh, a bawnghonte, a tuuhonte leh a neihsate uh tawh galmat-in la uh hi.
Amaute in Midian mite tenna khuapi khempeuh haltum uh a, a giahphualte uh a haltumsak uh hi.
Amaute in mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh a vekpi-in sutmangin buluh uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in Yericho nai, Yardan kiang, Moab leitamzang-a Mosheh, siampi Eleazar leh Israyl mihonte giahphual ah a galmatte tunpih uh hi.
Mosheh, siampi Eleazar leh mihon makaite khempeuh vai dawn dingin giahphual pualam ah paikhia uh hi.
Ahih hangin galdona panin hong ciah, a zaza a ukte leh a tultul a uk, galkapmangte tungah Mosheh heh hi.
Mosheh in amaute kiangah, “Numei khempeuh hing khawi na hi uh hiam?
En un, hih numeite pen Peor-a thupiang ah Yahweh tungah Israyl mite a gamta khialsak Balaam’ lamlahna tungtawnin Yahweh’ mihonte lakah pulnatna a piangsakte ahi uh hi.
Tu-in tua ahih manin pasalno peuhmah that unla, pasal tawh a lumkhinsa numei peuhmah zong that un.
Ahih hangin pasal tawh a lumkhawm ngei nai lo nungakno peuhmah nomau aa dingin kem un.

Tu-in note lakah mi khat peuhpeuh a thatte leh a kithatsa a lawng mi peuhmahte, giahphual pualam ah ni sagih sung pel loin na om ding uh hi. A ni thum ni leh a ni sagih ni-in note leh na galmatte uh na kisiansuah ding uh hi.
Puan khempeuh, savun tawh a kibawl na khempeuh, keel mul tawh a kibawl na khempeuh, leh sing tawh a kibawl na khempeuh na siansuah ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampi Eleazar in galdona ah a guansa mite kiangah, “Hih pen Yahweh in Mosheh tungah thu a piaksa thukham ahi hi:
kham, ngun, sumngo, sik, dal, leh haknaw,

mei a dozo peuhmah bek mei ah na hal ding uh hi; tuate a siang hi ding a, tua khit ciangin siansakna tui tawh tuate zong na siansuah ding uh hi. Ahih hangin mei a dozo lo peuhmah tua tui ah na koih pelmawh ding hi.
Tua ciangin note in ni sagihna ni khit ciangin na puansilhte uh na sawp ding uh a, na siang ding uh hi; tua khit ciangin giahphual sungah na lut thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“A kibuluh mihing leh ganhing khempeuh simna nei in. Nang leh siampi Eleazar, leh mihon lutang makaite in na sim ding uh hi.
Gal sunga a kingahte khen nih suah inla, galdo dingin a kuante leh inn-a om mihonte tungah a kikimin hawmsak in.
Gal kidona sungah a do mite kiang panin Yahweh aa dingin siah dingin mite pan, bawnghonte pan, laate pan, leh tuuhonte panin zanga ciangin khat ta a pia ding uh hi.
Tua panin alang la inla, Yahweh tungah vei-a biakna-in siampi Eleazar tungah pia in.

Israyl mihonte in alang a ngah uh sung panin mite, bawnghonte, laate, tuuhonte, a gankhawite khempeuh panin sawmnga ah khat ta na paipih ding uh a, Yahweh’ biakbuk a don dingin vaipuak a neite leh a kem Levi mite tungah na pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin Mosheh leh siampi Eleazar in a hih uh hi.
Galdo mite in a lakna panin a omlai pen tuu 675,000 hi a,
bawng 72,000,
pasal tawh a lumkhawm nai lo numei 32,000 ahi hi.
Sehtanh alang ahi galdona ah a kuankhia mite ngah pen tuu 337,500 ahi hi.
Hih tuute panin Yahweh’ siah pen 675 ahi hi.
Bawng 36,000 panin Yahweh’ siah pen 72 ahi hi.
Laa 30,500 panin Yahweh’ siah pen 61 ahi hi.
Mihing 16,000 panin Yahweh’ siah pen 32 ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin Mosheh in Yahweh’ i vei-a biakna siah pen siampi Eleazar tungah a pia hi.
Gal kuan mite kiang panin Mosheh in a khenkhiat Israyl mite aa ahi alang pen—
Mihonte ngah alang pen tuu 337,500 hi a,
bawng 36,000,
mihing 16,000 ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin Israyl mite’ ngah alang panin mihing leh ganhing sawmnga ah khat ta Mosheh in la a, Yahweh’ biakbuk a don dingin vaipuak a neite leh a kem Levi mite tungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh kiangah a zaza a ukte leh a tultul a uk galkap honhonte tunga galkapmangte hong pai uh a,
9 amaute in, “Kote’ ukna nuai-a a om galkapte, na nasem kote in ka simkhin uh a, kote kiang panin khat zong a pelhem om lo hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahweh mai-ah komau’ mah aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawl nadingin kote hih zawh zah ciat tawh kizui-in kham vanzatte ahi banbuhte leh taaute, min gelhna khutbuhte, bilbahte, leh khite, Yahweh tungah biakna-in kong paipih uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Mosheh leh siampi Eleazar in amaute tung panin kham tawh kibawlsa kizepnate khempeuh sang uh hi.
A tultul ukte leh a zaza a ukte kiang panin Yahweh tungah a kipia kham khempeuh pen shekel 16,750; pound 450, a gik hi.
Gal sunga a kuan mite in amau aa dingin a la uh hi.
A tultul a zaza a ukte kiang panin Mosheh leh siampi Eleazar in khamte sang uh a, Yahweh mai-ah Israyl mite aa dingin phawkna khatin Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah paipih uh hi.
Reuben mite leh Gad mite in gankhawi tampitak nei uh hi. Amaute in Yazer gam leh Gilead gam pen khawi nadingin gam hoih mahmah ahihna a muh uh ciangin,
Mosheh leh siampi Eleazar, leh mihon makaite mai-ah Gad mite leh Reuben mite hong pai-in a gen inah:
“Ataroth, Dibon, Yazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Shebam, Nebo, leh Beon—
Israyl mite mai-ah Yahweh in hong ngahsak gam pen gankhawi-na gam hi a, na nasem kote in ganhon ka nei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Amaute in, “Kote in note muhna ah maipha na muh uh ahih leh, hih gam pen nasem kote tungah luah dingin hong pia unla, Yardan gal ah kote hong kaisak kei un,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Mosheh in Gad mite leh Reuben mite kiangah, “Hih tengah no na om hithiat laitakun na sanggamte uh galdona ah pai ding uh ahi hiam?
Yahweh in Israyl mite tungah a piak khitsa gam sungah a pai nading uh ah amaute bang hangin lungkiasak ding na hi uh hiam?
Hih pen Kadesh Barnea panin gam vaansim dingin ka sawl lai-in na pate uh gamtatna bang ahi hi.
Amaute Eshcol Kuam ah a paitoh uh ciangun, tua gam mu uh a, amaute in Israyl mite nakpitakin lungkiasakin Yahweh in amaute a piaksa gam sungah amaute paikha lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ni-in Yahweh nak heh mahmah a, Amah kiciamin:

Egypt gam panin a paikhia, kum 20 pan a tungsiah kuamah in Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob tungah ka ciamna gam mukha lo taktak ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in lungsim taktak tawh Kei hong zui lo a,
Keniz mi Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb leh Nun’ tapa Yahshua bek in lungsim taktak tawh Yahweh nungzui uh hi, ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl’ tungah Yahweh nak heh mahmah a, Yahweh’ muhna a gilo khangmite khempeuh a sih mateng kum 40 sung gamlak ah amaute vak kawikawisak hi.
Tu-in En in! Israyl-te tungah hih sangin Yahweh a hehzawk nadingin mawhna lomtang tawh a kidim na pate uh tangin hong khang na hi uh hiam!
Amah nungzuihna panin a pialkhiat uh leh, Amah in hih gamlak ah amaute nusiakik leuleu ding a, note pen hih mite khempeuh a susia na hi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiang nai-ah amaute hong pai-in, “Ka tuuhonte uh aa dingin tuukhawkte bawlin ka zi ka tate uh aa ding khuapite ka lam ding uh a,

ahih hangin kote in hiam tawi-in amau’ munah Israyl mite ka tunpih mateng Israyl mite aa dingin ka kiging ding uh a, hih gam sunga a teng mite kiang panin a kidalna dingun khuapi muanhuaite sungah ka zite uh leh ka tate uh a teng ding uh hi.
Israyl mite in amau luah ding ciat a ngah kim matengun ka innlum uh ah ka ciahkik kei ding uh hi.
Kote in Yardan adang pang lam leh a nung lam siah ah amaute tawh ka luah khawm kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yardan nisuahna lam kote ngah ding hong suak hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in amaute kiangah, “Na gen bangun na gamtat ding uh ahih leh— Yahweh mai-ah galdo dingin galhiam la-in,
Yahweh’ mai panin a galte Amah in a hawlkhiatkhit matengin ompihin galhiam tawi note in Yahweh mai-ah Yardan kantanin,

Yahweh mai-ah leitang a kilakhin a suah ciangin, note na ciahkik thei ding uh a, Yahweh’ mai leh Israyl-te mai-ah hong kimawhsak thei lo ding hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh mai-ah hih gam pen note neihsa hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin na gensa bangun na gamtat kei uh leh, hih gen kholhna ciamteh un: Yahweh tungah a mawhna hi ding uh a, na mawhna un hong sulzuih taktak kha ding hi.
Na zi leh na tate uh aa dingin khuapite lam unla, na tuute aa dingin tuukhawkte bawlin na kam panin a pusuak khempeuh bangin gamta un,” a ci hi.
Gad mite leh Reuben mite in Mosheh kiangah, “Ko, na nasemte in nangma thupiak bangin na khempeuh ka hih ding uh hi.
Ka tate uh, ka zite uh, ka ganhonte uh leh ka gankhawite khempeuh hih lai mun Gilead khuapite sungah na om ding uh a,
ahih hangin na nasem kote in Yahweh mai-ah galkuan dingin pasal peuhmah galhiam tawh kithawi-in nangma nong gensa bang lianin ka galkah ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in amaute tawh kisai-in siampi Eleazar tung, Nun’ tapa Yahshua tung, leh Israyl minamte’ innkuan lutangte tungah thuhilhnate gen hi.

Mosheh in amaute thu hilh a, “Gad mite leh Reuben mite in note tawh Yardan a kantanin, a milipin Yahweh mai-ah galkuan dingin galhiam tawi-in a kigingsa-in, note’ mai-ah leitang na ngah uh ciangin, note in Gilead gam pen a neihsa dingin amaute tungah na pia ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin note tawh galkuan dingin hong galkai kei leh, Canaan gam sung note lakah amaute in a luahte uh ngah veve ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Gad mite leh Reuben mite in, “Yahweh in na nasem kote tungah hong genkhitsa khempeuh, kote sep ding mah uh ahi hi.
Yahweh mai-ah galhiam tawi-in Canaan gam sungah ka pai ding uh a, ahih hangin kote’ luah ahi ka neihsa uh pen Yardan hih lampang mah hi ding hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Amor mite kumpi ahi Sihon’ kumpi gam leh Bashan mite’ kumpi ahi Og’ kumpi gam pen a gam sung huama om khuapite leh a gamsung kiimkot-a om khuapite tawh a gam buppi, Mosheh in Gad mite tung, Reuben mite tung, leh Yahseph’ tapa Menasheh minam alangte tungah pia hi.
Gad mite in Dibon, Araroth, leh Aroer khuapite lam uh a,
Atroth, Shophan, Yazer, leh Yogbehah,
Beth Nimrah, leh Beth Haran—a vekin khuapi muanhuai-in lam a, amaute in a tuute aa dingin tuukhawkte lam uh hi.
Reuben mite in Heshbon leh Elealah leh Kiryathiam khuapite lam a,
Nebo leh Baal Meon (*a minte a khel ding uh khuapi) leh Shibmah khuapite lam uh hi.
Gilead ah Menasheh minam alang ahi Machir mite pai-in va la uh a, tua sunga om Amor mite a hawkkhia mang uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in Menasheh suan Machir tungah Gilead pia a, tua tengah amah a teng hi.
Menasheh’ suan Yair in zong a khuaneute va la a, tuate Havoth Yair ci-in min a phuah hi. Havoth Yair pen Yair mite Tenna a cihna ahi hi.
Nobah in Kenath leh a kiimkot-a khuate va la a, amah in ama min mah tapsakin Nobah a phuak hi.
Hihte pen Mosheh leh Aaron’ makaihna tawh Egypt gam panin a honin a paikhiat lai-un Israyl mite’ khualzinnate ahi hi.

Yahweh’ thupiakna tawh mun khat panin adang mun khat ah mainawtin a paina uh mun ciat, a kipatkhiatna munte Mosheh in a khualzinna uh a gelhkhia hi. Hihte pen amau’ dinkhiatna tawh kizui-in amau’ kipatna munte ahi hi:
A Kha Masa kha sung, tua kha a ni sawm le ni nga ni-in Rameses panin amaute dingkhia uh hi; Paisan biakna a kipiakkhit a zingciang-in Egypt mite khempeuh muhna ah hangsantakin paikhia uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amaute laka a thahsak amau’ tacil khempeuh Egypt mite in a vui laitak uh hi. Egypt-te’ pasiante khempeuh tungah zong Yahweh in thukhennate a neikhin ahi hi.

Pi Hahiroth nai panin amaute dingkhia uh a, tuipi laizang kantanin sehnel gam ah a pai uh hi. Etham Sehnel gam sungah amaute ni thum khualzinna lam pai uh a, Marah ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Marah panin amaute dingkhia a, Elim ah a tung uh hi. Elim ah cik tuikhuk 12 leh nisuh kung 70 om hi; tua ahih manin amaute in tua lai-ah giahphual sat uh hi.
Elim panin amaute dingkhia uh a, Tuipi San kiangah giahphual a sat uh hi.

Mithkah panin amaute dingkhia uh a, Hashmonah ah giahphual a sat uh hi.

Ahih hangin note mai panin tua gam mite na hawlkhiat kei uh leh, note in na omsak lai mite pen note mittang sunga om nin tawh a kibang hi ding a, na pang uh hong sun lingte tawh kibang ding hi. Amaute bangmah hi lo napi-in ahih hangin na tenna gam sungah note hong gimsak ding uh hi.
Tua banah amaute tungah hih dinga ka geelsa om bangin note tungah zong kong hih ding hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite thupia inla, amaute kiangah gen in: Canaan gam sungah na tun uh ciangin, note luah-in aisanna tawh na ngah uh gam pen—note gam in hih gamgite nei ding uh hi—
na leitaw lam gamgi uh pen Edom gamgi dunga Zin Sehnel gam pawlkhat kihel ding hi. Nisuahna lama na leitaw lam gamgi uh pen Ci Tuipi; Tuipi Si, mong panin kipan ding a,
Akrabim Paitohna leitaw lamah kawi-in Zin dong banin, Kadesh Barnea pan leitaw lamah pai ding hi. Tua khit ciangin Hazar Addar lamah paisuakin Azmon dongah pai ding hi.
Azmon panin gamgi kihei ding a, Egypt Lui zui ding a, Mediterranean Tuipi ah tawp ding hi.
Ni tumna lam na Gamgi uh pen Tuipi Lian; Mediterranean Tuipi, dung gei teng hi ding hi. Tua pen ni tumna lama na gamgi uh hi ding hi.
Na Leilu lam Gamgi ding uh pen Tuipi Lian; Mediterranean Tuipi, panin Hor Mual dong ah na gamgi uh pai ding a,
Hor Mual panin Hamath khua lutna ciang dong pai ding a, Zedad ah pai-in,
Ziphron ah kizom ding a, Hazar Enan ah tawp ding hi. Tua pen leilu lama na gamgi uh hi ding hi.

Shepham panin Ain nisuahna lam pang-a om Riblah ah tuaksuk ding a, Kinnereth Tuipi; Galilee Tuipi, gei nisuahna lam dong kizom ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yardan dung zuisuk ding a, Ci Tuipi; Tuipi Si, ah tawp ding hi. Hih gamgite pen note gamgi hi ding a, tua gamgi’ huam sunga gam pen note gam hi ding hi, ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Mosheh in Israyl mite thupia-in a gen inah, “Hih pen aisanna tawh na luah ding uh leitang ahi hi. Minam kuate tung leh minam-alang tungah a kipia dingin Yahweh in thupiakhin hi.
Reuben minam, Gad minam, Yahseph’ tapa Menasheh minam-alang-te in amau luah gam ngahkhinzo ta uh hi.
Minam nihte leh minam-alang-te in nisuahna lam ahi Yardan Gun nisuahna lam, Yericho nai, Yardan dung hih lampang ah amau’ luah ding ngah khinzo uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Hihte pen note lakah luah dingin leitang a hawm ding mite’ minte ahi hi: siampi Eleazar leh Nun’ tapa Yahshua ahi hi.
Nangmah in luah dingin gam a hawm dingin minam sim ah makai khatta na seh ding hi.
Hihte pen a kiseh mite’ minte ahi hi: Yahdah minam panin makai, Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb;
Simeon minam panin makai, Ammihud’ tapa Shemuel,
Benyamin minam panin makai, Kison’ tapa Elidad,
Dan minam panin makai, Yoga’ tapa Bukki,
Yahseph’ Menasheh minam panin makai, Ephod’ tapa Hanniel,
Yahseph’ tapa Ephraim minam panin makai, Shiphtan’ tapa Kemuel,
Zebulun minam panin makai, Parnach tapa Elizaphan,
Issachar minam panin makai, Azzan’ tapa Pattier,
Asher minam panin makai, Shelomi’ tapa Ahihud,
Naphtali minam panin makai, Ammihud’ tapa Pedahel ahi hi.
Hihte pen Canaan gam sung, Israyl mite lakah gam a hawm dingin Yahweh in thu a piak mite ahi hi.
Yericho nai Yardan kiang Moab leitamzang ah Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Amaute in amau’ neih a luah uh sung panin tenna dingin Levi mite tungah khuapite a piak nadingun Israyl mite thu pia in. Hih khuapite kiimkot-a neihkhop-gam zong Levi mite tungah na pia ding uh hi.
Hih khuapite pen amau’ teenna ding leh a kiimkot-a gam awng khempeuh pen amau’ bawnghonte, gankhawi honte, leh a ganhingte aa ding ahi hi.
Levi mite tunga na piak ding uh khuapite kiimkot-a gam awngte pen khuapikulh panin a kiimkot pi 3,000 ciang ban ding hi.

Khuapi pualam ah, apang khat ciat pi 3,000 na teh ding a, nisuahna lampang pi 3,000, leitaw lampang pi 3,000, leilu lampang pi 3,000, ni tumna lampang pi 3,000 hi ding a, a laizangah khuapi om ding hi. Hih pen Levi ngeina khuapi panin a kiimkot khempeuh ah pi 3,000 ciang dong a ban leitang ahi hi. Pi 1,500 pen gankhawi nadingin gam awng hi a, a omlai pi 1,500 pen lote leh leenggah lote aa ding ahi hi; hih khempeuh pen “Neihkhop-gam” ahi hi. Hih pen amau’ khuapite aa dingin neihkhop-gam-in amaute aa ahi hi.
Levi mite tungah na piak uh khuapite panin khuapi guk pen mi a that khatpeuh a tai nading bukna khuapite hi ding hi. Hih khuapi gukte banah note in khuapi 42 na pia thuah ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Levi mite tungah na piak ding uh khuapite pen a vekin khuapi 48 hi ding a, tuate pen neihkhop-gam tawh na pia khawm ding uh hi.

Israyl mite’ neihsa gam panin Levi mite tungah na piak uh khuapite pen minam khat ciat panin a kituak dimdiamin na pia ding uh hi. Minam tamte tung panin note in khuapi tampi na pia ding uh a, minam tawmte tung panin a tawmzaw na pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite hopih inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Yardan kantanin Canaan gam sungah na pai uh ciangin,
sawm lopi-in mi khatpeuh a thatkha mi thatte a va tai theih nadingin, note aa dingin bukna khuapi dingin khuapite na seh ding uh hi.
Tuate pen phu-lapa kiang panin bukna khuapite hi ding hi; tua hileh mi that khialpa pen mihonte mai-a thukhenna ah a din ma-in amah silo pah ding hi.
Na piak uh khuapi khempeuh panin, guk pen bukna khuapite hi ding hi.
Bukna khuapi dingin Yardan hih lampang ah khuapi thum na seh ding uh a, Canaan gam sungah khuapi thum na seh ding uh hi.

Hih khuapi gukte pen Israyl mite aa ding, peemta-te aa ding, note laka hong peem khualmite aa dingin bukna hi ding hi; tua hileh sawm lopi-in adang mi khat a that khialkha mi khat peuhpeuh in tua lai munah bukna mu thei ding hi.
Ahih hangin mi khat in na-a a kizang sik khat tawh midang khat sat a, tua hangin mipa a sih leh, amah mi that ahi hi. Tua mi that pa kithat taktak ding hi.
Ahih keileh khatpeuh in a khut sungah thah theih nading suang tawi-in, amah in mi khat a satna hangin mipa a sih leh, amah mi that ahi hi; mi that pa pen kithat taktak ding hi.
Ahih keileh khatpeuh in a khut sungah hiam-in a kizang sing khat tawi-in, mi khatpeuh a satna hangin mipa a sih leh, amah mi that ahi hi. Mi thatpa pen kithat taktak ding hi.
Sisan-phulami, amah ngiat in mi thatpa sihna ah tun ding hi. Amah in tua mipa a muh ciangin, a that ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in muhdahna tawh sawmkholhna nei-in, adang khat sawnin ahih keileh sawmkholhna tawh a denna hangin amah si-in,

ahih keileh kimuhdahna nei-in amah in a khuttum tawh a tupna hangin a sih leh, a tuum mipa kithat taktak ding hi; ahang in amah mi that khat ahi hi. Sisan-phulapa in amah amuh ciangin, amah in mi thatpa that ding hi.
Ahih hangin kigal neihna om lopi-in, mi khat in adang khat sawnkha-in, sawm lopi-in na khatpeuh tawh dengkha-in,
amah kimu loin, amah a sisak zo ding suang khat in amah kha-in a sih leh, mipa pen ama gal hi lo a, ama siat nading a zong hi lo ahih manin,
Hih thukhennate tawh kizui-in mihonte in amahs leh sisan-phulapa kikalah thukhen pelmawh ding hi.

Hih thute ah sisan-phulapa’ khut panin mihonte in mi thatin a kimawh pa hu pelmawh ding uh a, amah a tai theih nading bukna khuapi ah amah sawl ding uh hi. Sathau siangtho tawh sathau a kinilh Siampi Lianpa’ sih mateng tua lai mun ah pel loin amah om ding hi.
Ahi zongin ama taina bukna khuapi a kiciangtanna khengin paikhia a,
sisan-phulapa in bukna khuapi kiciangtanna pualam ah a muh leh, sisan-phulapa in a kingawh mipa that thei ding a, amah pen in a thatna hangin mawhna om lo ding hi;

Bang hang hiam cihleh siampi lianpa sih mateng ama bukna khuapi ah a kingawh mipa om pelmawh ding hi. Ahih hangin siampi lianpa a sihkhit ciangin a kingawh mipa pen ama neihsa leitang ah ciahkik thei ding hi.
Hih thukhennate pen na tenna khempeuh uh ah na khang tawntungun aa dingin thukhenna ngeina kip khat ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh a that mipa pen tecipang nih ahih keileh nih sangin a tamzaw tecipang a om leh bek mi thah nahangin kithat ding a, ahih hangin teci khat bek teci panna siksanin kuamah kithat lo ding hi.
A si dingin a kidantat mi that-te kitatna ding sum na sang peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Amah pen pel loin kithat taktak ding hi.
Siampi lianpa sihma-in amah ciahkikin a gam sungah a ten theih nadingin, bukna khuapi sungah a tai khatpeuh kitat nadingin kitatna khatpeuh na sang peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Na paina uh gam na thanghuaisak peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Sisan in leitang ninsak a, sisan a suah mipa’ sisan lo tawh sisan a kisuahna leitang aa dingin mawhkhuhna kibawlsak thei lo hi.

Tua ahih ciangin na tenna uh leitang leh mite laka Ka omna leitang ninsakin na thanghuaisak kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah, Yahweh pen Israyl mite lakah ka teng hi, ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Yahseph’ tapa Menasheh, Menasheh’ tapa Machir, Machir’ tapa Gilead beh innkuan lutangte in Mosheh mai leh Israyl mi lutangte mai-ah a gen inah:
“Aisanna tawh Israyl mite tungah gamh luah dingin leitang piak dingin Yahweh in nang thu hong piak ciangin, Amah in ka sanggampa uh Zelophehad gamh pen a tanute tungah na piak nadingin hong hilh hi.

Tu-in amaute pen Israyl mi sungah minam dangte’ tapate khatpeuh tawh kiteng leh, ka pate uh gamhluah panin amau aa teng kilakhia-in a manawh minamte tungah tua gamh kipia beh ding hi. Tua ahih manin ko ngah gamh a kikhenkhia ding a suak hi.

Tua ciangin Israyl mite’ Jubilee hong tun ciangin, amau gamh pen amau’ tenpih minamte’ gamh ah kibehlap ding a, amau neihsa pen ka pu kapate uh namte’ gamhluah panin amau aa a kilakhia a suak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh’ Thukham tawh kizui-in Mosheh in Israyl mite thupia-in a gen inah, “Yahseph’ suan minamte in thuman a gen uh ahi hi.
Hih pen Zelophehad’ tanute aa dingin Yahweh in a thupiak ahi hi: ‘A pate nam beh sungah a ut peuhpeuh uh tawh kiteng thei ding uh hi.
Israyl sunga gamhte minam khat panin minam khat ah paikhia lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl mi khempeuh a minam gamhluah ciat uh tawh kip ding hi.
Israyl mite sung panin minam khat peuhpeuh ah gamh a nei tanu khempeuh pen a pate’ nam sung khat peuhpeuh’ zi hi ding hi. Hih bang danin Israyl mite khempeuh in a pate uh gamh luah thei ding uh hi.
Minam khat panin adang khat ah gamh paikhia lo ding hi. Minam khempeuh in amau’ gamh ciat keem ding uh hi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bang tektekin Zelophehad’ tanute gamta uh hi:
Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, leh Noah-te in amau’ pate lam a pa’ sanggamte tapate tawh a kiteng uh hi.
Amaute in Yahseph’ ta Menasheh’ suanlekhakte’ behte sung mah ah pasal nei uh a, amau’ gamh pen a pa’ beh leh minam sung mah ah kip hi.
Hihte pen Yerikho nai Yardan kiang Moab leitamzang ah Mosheh tungtawnin Israyl mite tungah Yahweh in a piak Thukhamte leh thukhennate ahi hi.
